programme.title: S5E11 - 9-1-1: Lone Star
programme.desc: Një zjarrfikës i Nju Jorkut zhvendoset në Austin, Teksas me djalin e tij, ku punon për të shpëtuar jetën e njerëzve ndërsa përpiqet të zgjidhë problemet e tij personale.

programme.title: S6E1 - Chicago Med
programme.desc: Një emocion përmes kaosit të përditshëm të spitalit më eksploziv të qytetit dhe ekipit kurajoz të mjekëve që e mbajnë atë së bashku. Ato do të trajtojnë raste unike të reja të frymëzuara nga ngjarje aktuale, duke krijuar marrëdhënie të zjarrta në pandemonium pulsues të dhomës së urgjencës.

programme.title: Shpikja e gënjeshtrës
programme.desc: Ricky Gervais, Jennifer Garner, Jonah Hill. Në një botë ku të gjithë thonë vetëm të vërtetën, një shkrimtar i dështuar do të ndryshojë fatin e tij duke shpikur gënjeshtrën dhe duke e përdorur atë për të arritur gjithçka që do...

programme.title: S2E5 - Të Gjithë Cmënden pas Rejmondit
programme.desc: Rei Barone i ka të gjitha në jetë: një familje të madhe, një punë të mirë dhe një shtëpi të bukur. Problemi i vetëm i tij janë prindërit dhe vëllai i tij xheloz, të cilët jetojnë në anën tjetër të rrugës. Telashet nuk kanë të sosur në këtë familje të madhe, por Reimondi ka mësuar si t’i përballojë ato.

programme.title: Total Siyapaa
programme.desc: Aman, a Pakistani man living in London, falls in love with Asha, an Indian woman. But he must convince her parents to let them get married, despite their different nationalities. Release Year: 2014 Director: Eeshwar Nivas Awards: 2005 Winner Special Award - Ramesh Sippy - Best film in the last 50 years of Indian cinema.

programme.title: Duplicate
programme.desc: A criminal and a chef look alike which helps the former to conduct his illegal activities. Release Year: 1998 Director: Mahesh Bhatt.

programme.title: Student Of The Year 2
programme.desc: Rohan follows his lover, Mridula, to St Teresa's college hoping to reunite with her. There, he befriends Manav, the most popular student, but is constantly at loggerheads with his sister, Shreya. Release Year: 2019 Director: Punit Malhotra Awards: Filmfare Awards, Zee Cine Awards.

programme.title: Pyar Kiya To Darna Kya
programme.desc: Suraj falls for Muskan, but her possessive brother dislikes him. To win her, Suraj must first win over her brother and uncle. Release Year: 1998 Director: Sohail Khan Awards: 1999 Winner R.D. Burman Award- Kamaal Khan- For 'O o jaane jaana'.

programme.title: Karuppu
programme.desc: Possessed by a powerful deity, a dedicated lawyer fights for marginalized communities while balancing terrifying divine callings with everyday challenges of the legal profession.

programme.title: Kalank
programme.desc: Long-buried secrets come to light when romance blossoms between a young daredevil and a beautiful woman in 1945 India. Release Year: 2019 Director: Abhishek Varman.

programme.title: Mantostan
programme.desc: Mantostan.

programme.title: Patna Shuklla
programme.desc: Tanvi Shukla, a lawyer in Patna's lower court, who is living her childhood dream of becoming a lawyer. Release Year: 2024 Director: Vivek Budakoti Awards: 2024 Winner Popular Award- Most Popular ActreSS in a Web Series Drama- Raveena Tandon.

programme.title: Saas Bahu Aur Sensex
programme.desc: Upper middle-class women quit daytime soaps to start investing in the stock market, seeking financial independence, new skills, and chances to shape their futures. Release Year: 2008 Director: Shona Urvashi.

programme.title: Tum
programme.sub-title: A Dangerous Obsession
programme.desc: Kamini craves for affection from her husband, who has no time for her. Her life changes when Jatin, a photographer, befriends her and later becomes obsessed with her. Release Year: 2004 Director: Aruna Raje.

programme.title: Dear Dad
programme.desc: A teenager and his father form a special bond with each other while on an unplanned road trip from their home in Delhi. Release Year: 2016 Director: Tanuj Bhramar.

programme.title: Kaagaz 2
programme.desc: The Struggles of a common man whose right to life is infringed upon by protests and rallies. Release Year: 2024 Director: V.K. Prakash.

programme.title: Hum Kisise Kum Nahin
programme.desc: Gangster Munna Bhai meets Komal and falls in love with her. In order to marry her, he must first convince Dr. Rastogi, Komal's elder brother. Release Year: 2002 Director: David Dhawan.

programme.title: Badrinath Ki Dulhaniya
programme.desc: Badrinath Ki Dulhaniya.

programme.title: Jab We Met
programme.desc: Aditya, a wealthy businessman, aimlessly boards a train and meets Geet, a bubbly girl who plans to elope with her lover. Release Year: 2007 Director: Imtiaz Ali Awards: 2 National Film Awards, 8 Filmfare Awards, 8 IIFA Awards.

programme.title: Khatta Meetha
programme.desc: Sachin Tichkule is an ambitious contractor who faces opposition from everyone, both at home and at work. But he continues to struggle.

programme.title: Darr
programme.desc: Rahul is obsessed with Kiran and stalks her constantly. However, Rahul goes berserk when she gets engaged to Sunil, a navy officer, and he decides to forcefully claim Kiran for himself. Release Year: 1993 Director: Yash Chopra Awards: Filmfare Awards- Best Comedian/Comedienne Anupam Kher, Silver Lotus Award- Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment Yash Chopra.

programme.title: Fatso
programme.desc: On discovering that his death was a mistake, Navin demands to be sent back to earth. Now he has to woo his fianc all over again in another guise. Release Year: 2012 Director: Rajat Kapoor.

programme.title: Bioscopewala
programme.desc: A woman meets her dead father's old friend, who was the operator of a Bioscope show that she loved in her childhood. Connecting India and Afghanistan, a story of love and cinema unfolds. Release Year: 2018 Director: Deb Medhekar Awards: 2018 Nominee FOI Online Award - Best Screenplay Adapted - Deb Medhekar, Radhika Anand.

programme.title: Atithi Tum Kab Jaoge
programme.desc: A tired working couple hosts an uninvited guest who refuses to depart, suddenly turning their routine evening into a tense, humorous test of hospitality and boundaries. Release Year: 2010 Director: Ashwni Dhir Awards: 2011 Winner Apsara Award- Best Comic Actor- Paresh Rawal, 2011 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award- Most Profitable Actor- Ajay Devgn.

programme.title: Vijay The Master
programme.desc: A professor with a drinking problem goes to a school for young people. He argues with a bad person who makes the students do crimes.

programme.title: Luka Chupi
programme.desc: Reporter Guddu and Rashmi begin a live-in relationship after falling in love. However, their lives become complicated when their families assume they have run away together and create confusion. Release Year: 2019 Director: Laxman Utekar Awards: 2020 Winner Special Award - Star Plus Nayi Baat Award.

programme.title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
programme.desc: Kal Ho Naa Ho.

programme.title: Partner
programme.desc: A 'Love Guru' assists other males, woos a widowed single mother, but becomes embroiled in controversies. Release Year: 2007 Director: David Dhawan Awards: 2008 Winner Popular Award- Best Performance in a Comic Role- Govinda, 2008 Winner Popular Award- Best Supporting Actor- Govinda.

programme.title: Queen
programme.desc: Rani, a Delhi girl ditched before her wedding, travels solo for her honeymoon, discovers new experiences, meets diverse people, and ultimately finds her own identity. Release Year: 2014 Director: Vikas Bahl.

programme.title: War 2
programme.desc: Working as a mercenary, Kabir accepts a high-risk mission for a criminal network. But soon, his task pits him against his unflinching former ally. Release Year: 2025 Director: Ayan Mukerji.

programme.title: Agneepath
programme.desc: A young man's quest for revenge against a ruthless crime lord transforms him into a force of justice, testing his spirit, morals, and the sacrifices demanded by destiny. Release Year: 2012 Director: Karan Malhotra.

programme.title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
programme.desc: A story of relationship turmoil that centres around a budding romance between Dev and Maya, who are both married to different people. Release Year: 2006 Director: Karan Johar Awards: Best ActreSS in a Leading Role: Rani Mukherji Awards of the International Indian Film Academy; Best Supporting Actor: Abhishek Bachchan Filmfare Awards; Jodi No. 1: Rani Mukherji and Shah Rukh Khan Screen Weekly Awards; Best Playback Singer Female: Alka Yagnik Zee Cine Awards.

programme.title: Bal Hanuman Return Of The Demon
programme.desc: A crocodile demon is brought to life by his evil followers to create a reign of terror on the earth. The Demon King with his devilish force creates havoc on earth. Release Year: 2010 Director: Pankaj Sharma.

programme.title: Teen They Bhai
programme.desc: Harpreet, Chiksi and Fancy are three brothers who don't get along with each other. However, they decide to meet each other after their grandfather, who has left behind a vast fortune, expires. Release Year: 2011 Director: Mrigdeep Singh Lamba.

programme.title: Raju Chacha
programme.desc: A mischievous youngster stumbles into unexpected trouble, creating chaos that leads to comedic twists, heartfelt moments, and valuable lessons. Release Year: 2000 Director: Anil Devgan.

programme.title: Action Replayy
programme.desc: Fed-up with his parents constantly fighting, a young boy goes back in time to make his parents fall in love. This leads to hilarious situations. Release Year: 2010 Director: Vipul Amrutlal Shah Awards: 2011 Nominee Dainik Bhaskar Bollywood Award- Jodi of the Year- Akshay Kumar, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan.

programme.title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
programme.desc: Prem, a school dropout, hesitantly marries an educated but overweight girl, Sandhya. However, the two come closer when they take part in a race, which involves Prem carrying Sandhya on his back. Release Year: 2015 Director: Sharat Katariya Awards: National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Hindi, National Film Award for Best Lyrics, National Film Award for Best Playback Singer Female, Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut Bhumi Pednekar, Filmfare Award for Best Cinematograph.

programme.title: Chandni
programme.desc: Chandni's fiance, Rohit, is paralysed in an accident and she is forced to relocate to Mumbai where her boss, Lalit, falls for her. However, she faces a dilemma when Rohit returns and woos her too. Release Year: 1989 Director: Yash Chopra Awards: Filmfare Awards- Best Cinematographer- Manmohan Singh.

programme.title: Badhaai Ho
programme.desc: A 25-year-old man tries to suppress his embarrassment when his mother announces that she is pregnant. Release Year: 2018 Director: Amit Ravindrenath Sharma Awards: 2019 Winner Popular Award - Best Film, 2019 Nominee Screen Award - Best Film, 2019 Nominee Main Award - Best Film, 2019 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award - The 100 Crore Club.

programme.desc: A young American traveller gears up for an epic road trip along Route 66 that spans across various states, time zones and heritage sites.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.sub-title: The host, Jamie, visits Polar Park, Norway, where he encounters the rich wildlife of the region by observing lynxes and wolves, snuggling with Alaskan Huskies and going on dog sled rides
programme.desc: The host embarks on thrilling journeys across the globe, exploring unique cultures, landscapes and seeking out extraordinary travel experiences that showcase the beauty of each destination.

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: లూనీ ట్యూన్స్ కార్టూన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: బగ్స్ బన్నీ, డాఫీ డక్, పోర్కీ పిగ్, ట్వీటీ, రోడ్ రన్నర్, ఇతర పాత్రలు వరుస హాస్యాస్పదమైన సాహసాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

programme.title: లాంపట్
programme.sub-title: A clever orange nutcase, Lamput, escapes from a hidden laboratory, thus sending scientists Slim Doc and Fat Doc in a frenzy as they try hard to capture him. However, Lamput always manages to escape
programme.desc: ఆరెంజ్ నట్కేస్ లాంపట్ ను శాస్త్రవేత్తలు స్లిమ్ డాక్, ఫ్యాట్ డాక్ పట్టుకోవాలనుకున్నప్పుడు అతను ప్రతిసారీ తప్పించుకుంటాడు.

programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: లూనీ ట్యూన్స్ కార్టూన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: బగ్స్ బన్నీ, డాఫీ డక్, పోర్కీ పిగ్, ట్వీటీ, రోడ్ రన్నర్, ఇతర పాత్రలు వరుస హాస్యాస్పదమైన సాహసాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.title: లా ఫామిలీ వీజీ
programme.sub-title: Weasy, an opportunistic weasel with a penchant for burglary, finds himself incubating a large egg, which leads to significant changes in his life
programme.desc: దొంగతనాల పట్ల మక్కువ కలిగిన, అవకాశవాది 'వీజీ' అనే ముంగిస అనుకోకుండా ఒక పెద్ద గుడ్డును పొదిగే బాధ్యతను స్వీకరిస్తుంది.

programme.title: योग ऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी
programme.sub-title: Ancient techniques of meditation and adoption of specific bodily postures widely practised for health and relaxation
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक योग और स्वास्थ्य संबंधी सुझावों के माध्यम से आध्यात्मिक अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, तथा प्राकृतिक उपचारों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हुए आंतरिक शांति को बढ़ावा देते हैं।.

programme.title: रोगानुसार आयुर्वेद एवं जीवन दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Acharya Balkrishna Ji, a prominent yoga and Ayurveda scholar, talks about the importance of medicinal plants and their uses
programme.desc: प्रमुख योग और आयुर्वेद विद्वान आचार्य बालकृष्ण जी विभिन्न औषधीय पौधों के महत्व और उनके उपयोग के बारे में बात करते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्या दीदी मां ऋतंभराजी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers an enlightening discourse on the holy scriptures and encourages devotees to live a spiritual life
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक पवित्र शास्त्रों पर ज्ञानवर्धक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: संत राजिंदर सिंहजी
programme.sub-title: Sant Rajinder Singh Ji Maharaj, current head of Science of Spirituality or Sawan Kirpal Ruhani Mission, is internationally recognised for his work towards inner and outer peace through spirituality
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक संत राजिंदर सिंहजी महाराज आध्यात्मिकता और रहस्यवाद के बारे में प्रवचन देते हैं जो अपने कार्यों के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर पहचाने जाते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य सतपालजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Shri Satpal Ji Maharaj's mission is primarily to ignite the spiritual flame in man. The knowledge he teaches, frees one from all restrictions and liberates the mind from all layers of ignorance
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक भक्ति और आत्म-साक्षात्कार से परिचय कराते हैं, तथा दर्शकों को आंतरिक शांति और जीवन के उद्देश्य की गहरी समझ की ओर मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: Tiger Mafia
programme.desc: Tiger Mafia.

programme.title: Cheetah: The Maasai Brotherhood
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on the Tana Bora, an alliance of five cheetahs who have grown into a formidable hunting unit that takes down large prey and survives super predators of the savannah.

programme.title: Glorious Grasslands
programme.desc: Like a sea of grass, the savannah, prairie and meadows are among the most productive habitats on Earth, housing some of the greatest concentrations of big game and dramatic interactions between predator and prey.

programme.title: Wild Battleground
programme.sub-title: Animals face challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: Different animals use the terrain and their unique attributes to their advantage and defeat their opponents at each location, becoming masters of communication, camouflage, diplomacy, and combat.

programme.title: Hippos After Dark
programme.desc: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers
programme.sub-title: Chris and Jess head to the outskirts of Sydney, Australia, to capture an elusive red-bellied black snake; a coastal carpet python needs help out of a drainpipe; Stuart and Olivia make a rare find
programme.desc: Australia's busiest snake-catching team face off against some of the world's deadliest animals, tackling everything from red bellies to eastern browns and whip snakes.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: Australia's busiest snake-catching team face off against some of the world's deadliest animals, tackling everything from red bellies to eastern browns and whip snakes.

programme.title: China's Wild Secrets
programme.sub-title: In southwestern China, towering mountains provide shelter for nearly 2,000 wild giant pandas. Giant Panda National Park is three times the size of Yellowstone and is home to over 10,000 species
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of The Hermit Crab
programme.desc: Dives into the life cycle of hermit crabs in Guadeloupe as they embark on their migration journey to release their eggs into the ocean.

programme.title: Antelope Unsung Heroes Of The Plain
programme.desc: Antelope Unsung Heroes Of The Plain.

programme.title: Fear on the Savannah
programme.desc: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived, and fear overtook the park.

programme.title: Dogs In The Land Of Lions
programme.desc: We follow the unforgettable journey of a family of wild dogs in Zimbabwe and witness rarely seen behaviour, from tender moments with newborn pups, to the thrills of hunting wildebeest, to close encounters with their greatest enemy - the lion.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
programme.sub-title: Prowling the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard
programme.desc: Set against Kyrgyzstan's rugged mountains, Dan O'Neill embarks on a mission to protect one of the world's most elusive creatures: the snow leopard. Following Dan as he works to build a new research centre dedicated to studying these majestic cats.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: Exploring life-defining battles amongst the animal kingdom's greatest rivals. Like gladiatorial battles, the animal showdowns are set in different wild 'arenas', including the Pacific Northwest, African savannah, jungle coasts, and Australia.

programme.title: Search For The King Cobra
programme.desc: Austin Stevens, a photographer and herpetologist, travels to the remote jungles of Southern India in pursuit of the world's largest venomous snake, the king cobra.

programme.title: Iberian Vipers
programme.desc: Exploring the behaviour, unique characteristics, and survival strategies of venomous vipers in the Iberian Peninsula.

programme.title: Rainforest Rewild
programme.desc: Rainforest Rewild.

programme.title: Tigress Blood
programme.desc: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey.

programme.title: Life Of A Predator
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: Wolves: Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: Europe's Amazon
programme.sub-title: Going on a 750km journey down the Drava river, starting with the current's Alpine origins to its delta in the Pannonian Basin
programme.desc: At the confluence of the Drava and Danube rivers lies one of Central Europe's best-kept secrets: an inland delta. Concealed behind the Iron Curtain for 50 years, this pristine wetland ecosystem has remained largely untouched and unexplored.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions
programme.sub-title: Five male lion cubs compete with each other while hunting their prey, but their family ties become increasingly complicated as they make their gradual rise to reign in the territory
programme.desc: In a journey that follows lions for the first five years of their lives, uncover fascinating insights into the lives of these majestic animals and discover the threats against them, such as poaching and habitat loss.

programme.title: Natural Born Monsters
programme.sub-title: Sean Duggan travels to Thailand to investigate the giant snakehead fish in its native habitat. Sean's expedition takes him from Thailand to snakehead-infested Arkansas to see if this killer fish can be stopped
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: The Hippo King
programme.desc: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship.

programme.title: Wild Sri Lanka
programme.sub-title: Many species unique to Sri Lanka live nowhere except its central highlands, but the cloud forests are threatened by the tea trade
programme.desc: For its size, Sri Lanka is one of the most biologically diverse places on Earth.

programme.title: Night on Earth: Africa
programme.desc: Exploring the incredible odyssey and nocturnal adventures of African elephants, who must migrate across wild and dangerous terrain in order to survive.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: The Teeth of the Savannah
programme.desc: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there.

programme.title: Lions Versus Hyenas
programme.desc: The filmmaker delves into the misunderstood rivalry between lions and hyenas, shedding light on their conflict and offering new insights into their complex relationship.

programme.title: Big Cats of the Serengeti
programme.desc: Cameras reveal the last secrets of Africa's largest wild lions by following two prides.

programme.title: Big Cat Tales
programme.sub-title: A dispersed Marsh Pride faces weakened protection from the six male warrior lions. Plus, a cheetah works tirelessly to raise her three new cubs
programme.desc: The intimate lives of lions, leopards and cheetahs of the Masai Mara; a journey of motherhood, survival, and territorial battles.

programme.title: Rise Of Jaguars
programme.desc: Rise Of Jaguars.

programme.title: Golden Eagle: Call of the Wild
programme.sub-title: Following the young bird on an adventurous odyssey from tender parental care to independence and on its challenging search for a territory of its own
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: Wild Kashmir
programme.desc: Wild Kashmir.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, the planet is a battleground as animals go head-to-head with their own kind.

programme.title: Big Cats Small World
programme.sub-title: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted when the winter floods arrive, and witness a scary encounter that gives leopard mum Sephiri a decision to make
programme.desc: Exploring the lives of big cats, shining a light on the worlds of leopards, lions, and cheetahs.

programme.title: Nature's Fast Attacks
programme.sub-title: In the battle between predator and prey, camouflage and speed often make the difference between life and death, as some of the fastest animals can strike and kill in the blink of an eye
programme.desc: From camouflaged hunters to the lethally fast, the deadliest predators in the world use all sorts of abilities to gain an advantage over their prey and kill in a matter of moments.

programme.title: Surviving Australia
programme.sub-title: Survivors recount incidents of being lost in the Australian wilderness, getting stuck underground, being caught in landslides, and having close encounters with some of the country's deadliest inhabitants
programme.desc: Survivors recount harrowing escapes from the Australian outback, while experts dismantle common myths to provide the raw tactics needed to stay alive.

programme.title: Rise Of Jaguars
programme.desc: Rise Of Jaguars.

programme.title: Italy: The Last Wilderness Year 1
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean beech woods are considered among the most beautiful and important on the continent
programme.desc: The story of a remarkable ecosystem in the heart of Europe. Beginning in Vienna, the Danube riverbank forests extend to the gates of Bratislava, forming a unique wildlife habitat.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee comes within a whisker of some of Earth's most majestic predators as he embarks on a remarkable journey through the feline family tree
programme.desc: Over two episodes, biologist Patrick Aryee goes on a journey to discover the amazing world of cat species that has spanned over 11 million years. While exploring the evolution of these mammals over the years Aryee also examines how these feline creatures have survived harsh environments, becoming king of the jungle as well as being a popular household pet. Cats are celebrated for their physical prowess, with their running, jumping and climbing skills second to no other animal in the world. Species featured on the show include caracals jumping to reach their prey, Siberian tigers in their natural landscape and rare footage reveals Bornean bay cats in action.

programme.title: River Monsters
programme.sub-title: When a sea monster washes up on an English beach, Jeremy Wade sets off to unmask the beast. His journey takes him to the ice sheets of Greenland and Norway
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade is not a fisherman; he's an `extreme angler' in search of the biggest and most dangerous freshwater fish, the kind with a taste for human flesh. This action-adventure series also features Wade illustrating how these river monsters are constructed to kill.

programme.desc: शोधकर्ताओं की एक टीम बोर्नियो में ब्लड ऑर्किड नामक फूल की खोज करती है, जो अनंत जीवन का रहस्य छिपा सकती है। हालाँकि, वैज्ञानिकों को जंगल के ख़तरनाक साँपों से जूझना पड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Johnny Messner (Bill Johnson),KaDee Strickland (Sam Rogers),Matthew Marsden (Dr. Jack Byron),Eugene Byrd (Cole Burris),Salli Richardson-Whitfield (Gail Stern),Nicholas Gonzalez (Dr. Ben Douglas),Karl Yune (Tran),Morris Chestnut (Gordon Mitchell)

programme.title: मुम्बै दिअरिएस्
programme.desc: The video diaries of a former tenant of his apartment fascinate the artist (Aamir Khan) who currently lives there, while an investment banker (Monica Dogra) befriends a pair of workers for a research project.

programme.title: मजिली
programme.sub-title: Poorna, an aspiring cricketer, falls into a deep depression after being abandoned by his lover, Anshu. Despite this, he is forced to marry his neighbour Sravani, who secretly has feelings for him
programme.desc: प्रेमिका, अंशु द्वारा छोड़े जाने के बाद, पूर्णा शराब में डूब जाता है और पड़ोसी श्रावणी से शादी करने के लिए मजबूर होता है। हालाँकि, वह जल्द ही उसके प्यार को महसूस करता है और उससे प्यार करने लगता है।.

credits.actor: Naga Chaitanya Akkineni (Poorna Chandra Rao),Samantha Ruth Prabhu (Sravani),Divyansha Kaushik (Anshu),Suhas (Jonty),Shivakumar Ramachandravarapu (Ganesh),Subbaraju (Corporator Bhushan),Rao Ramesh (Rama Chandra Rao),Atul Kulkarni (Navy Officer Rajeev),Krishna Murali Posani (Murari)

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, 2022 की कन्नड़ फ़िल्म 'केजीएफ: चैप्टर 2' के सेट से पर्दे के पीछे के दृश्य क्षण और विभिन्न अंश प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: बब्बर
programme.sub-title: Jorawar, a man with a criminal past, loses his parents in a horrifying incident. He longs for a simple life, but destiny has other plans
programme.desc: आपराधिक अतीत वाले ज़ोरावर के माता-पिता एक भयानक घटना में मारे जाते हैं। वह एक साधारण ज़िंदगी जीना चाहता है, लेकिन किस्मत को कुछ और ही मंज़ूर होता है।.

credits.actor: Raj Singh Jhinjar (Gamma Mechanic),Yograj Singh (Hakam),Aashish Duggal (Bai ji),Victor John (Jack),Yaad Grewal (Don),Pardeep Cheema (Tota)

programme.title: द कराटे किड
programme.sub-title: Dre, a young boy, finds himself bullied by Cheng, a rebellious kung fu prodigy at his school. However, things change after he befriends Mr Han, a maintenance man, who happens to be a kung fu expert
programme.desc: एक बच्चे ड्रे को उसके स्कूल का कुंग फू विजेता चेंग धमकाता है। हालाँकि, जब वह मिस्टर हान नामक एक रखरखाव करने वाले व्यक्ति से दोस्ती करके कुंग फू एक्सपर्ट बन जाता है, तो हालात बदल जाते हैं।.

credits.actor: Jaden Smith (Dre Parker),Jackie Chan (Mr. Han),Taraji P. programme.title: थम्मा
programme.sub-title: Two destined lovers battle supernatural forces, family ties, and nature itself to defend their forbidden romance in a mystical world where ancient powers and prophecies threaten to keep them apart
programme.desc: एक रहस्यमय दुनिया में प्राचीन शक्तियां उन्हें अलग रखने की धमकी देती हैं, दो नियतिबद्ध प्रेमी अपने वर्जित प्रेम संबंध की रक्षा के लिए अलौकिक शक्तियों, पारिवारिक बंधनों और स्वयं प्रकृति से लड़ते हैं।.

programme.title: लगान
programme.sub-title: During the British Raj, a farmer named Bhuvan accepts the challenge of Captain Andrew Russell to beat his team in a game of cricket and enable his village to not pay taxes for the next three years
programme.desc: ब्रिटिश राज के दौरान, भुवन, कैप्टन एंड्रयू रसेल की चुनौती स्वीकार करता है और क्रिकेट के खेल में उनकी टीम को हराने और अपने गाँव को अगले तीन वर्षों तक कर न देने में सक्षम बनाता है।.

programme.sub-title: K.G.F: Chapter 2 – 2022 – In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes. While his allies look up to him, the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy
programme.desc: रॉकी बड़ा होकर कोलार गोल्ड फील्ड्स के लोगों का नेता और रक्षक बनता है। लेकिन, अपनी माँ की इच्छाओं को पूरा करने के लिए उसे अधीरा, इनायत खलील और रमिका सेन का सामना करना पड़ता है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: A compilation of the best cases investigated in 'Crime Patrol' showcases people from different walks of life falling victim to the vices of others or their own
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: Bulent and Cat's survival skills are tested in a remote rainforest near Casa Loma, Colombia as they struggle to cope with the extreme weather and animals
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.sub-title: Experts delve into some of the major wars and assassinations carried out by monarchs to take over kingdoms, which shaped the course of modern India
programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ राजाओं द्वारा राज्यों पर अधिकार करने के लिए किए गए कुछ प्रमुख युद्धों और हत्याओं पर विस्तार से चर्चा करते हैं, जिन्होंने आधुनिक भारत की दिशा को आकार दिया।.

programme.title: एपीक खोज
programme.sub-title: The narrator sheds light on the origins of various communities settled in India along with their customs and traditions
programme.desc: कथाकार भारत में बसे विभिन्न समुदायों की उत्पत्ति के साथ-साथ उनके रीति-रिवाजों और परंपराओं के बारे में बताते हैं।.

programme.title: टेल्स ऑफ वेलोर
programme.sub-title: Indian soldiers narrate their stories of bravery from the wars that they fought for India. These soldiers went beyond their expected duties to protect their motherland
programme.desc: भारतीय सैनिक, देश के लिए बहादुरी से लड़े गए युद्ध की कहानियाँ सुनाते हैं। इन सैनिकों ने अपनी मातृभूमि की रक्षा के लिए अपने अपेक्षित कर्तव्यों से आगे बढ़कर काम किया।.

programme.title: भारत रत्न

programme.desc: एक प्रसिद्ध भारतीय शेफ कई तरह के स्वादिष्ट व्यंजनों की रेसिपी साझा करते हैं और स्टेप बाइ स्टेप उसे बनाकर दिखाते हैं।.

programme.title: एपिक टेल्स ऑफ लव
programme.sub-title: A compilation of some of the most popular love stories featuring legendary characters based on various significant Indian historical and cultural legends
programme.desc: विभिन्न महत्वपूर्ण भारतीय ऐतिहासिक और सांस्कृतिक किंवदंतियों पर आधारित पौराणिक पात्रों वाली कुछ सबसे लोकप्रिय प्रेम कहानियों का संकलन।.

programme.title: जायंट हब्स
programme.sub-title: The people behind major transport hubs around the world reveal what it takes to get millions of commuters and tons of cargo to their destinations every day
programme.desc: दुनिया भर में प्रमुख परिवहन केन्द्रों के पीछे काम करने वाले लोग बताते हैं, कि हर दिन लाखों यात्रियों और टन भर माल को उनके गंतव्य तक पहुंचाने के लिए कितनी मेहनत लगती है।.

programme.title: एपिपीडिया
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the lesser-known facts about the country of India through voyages that have enabled the documentation of the evolution of India
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता भारत के विकास को दिखाने के लिए, यात्राओं के माध्यम से भारत देश के ऐसे तथ्यों के बारे में बताते हैं जो पूर्णता ज्ञात नहीं है।.

programme.title: डिस्ट्रक्शन डिकोडेड
programme.sub-title: An in-depth look at catastrophic events, analysing the science behind natural and man-made disasters and exploring the causes and consequences through expert insights and CGI visuals
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम में प्राकृतिक और मानव निर्मित आपदाओं के पीछे के विज्ञान का विश्लेषण और अंतर्दृष्टि और सीजीआई दृश्यों के माध्यम से उनके कारणों और परिणामों पर जानकारी दी जाती है।.

programme.title: द ग्रेट इस्केप
programme.sub-title: Various artists re-enact the bravest escapes from captivity that prominent personalities have executed in the past across the world
programme.desc: विभिन्न कलाकार कैद से भागने की उन बहादुरीपूर्ण घटनाओं का पुनः मंचन करते हैं, जिन्हें प्रमुख लोगों ने अतीत में विश्व के विभिन्न भागों में अंजाम दिया था।.

programme.title: कही सुनी

programme.title: शरणम

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, भारत के विभिन्न धार्मिक स्थलों की यात्रा करते हैं, उनके सांस्कृतिक महत्व पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और तीर्थयात्रियों के अनुभव साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: बुद्ध सूत्र

programme.title: इंडिपीडिया
programme.sub-title: The host travels to different states in India and learns more about the customs and traditions that have been a part of the country since ancient times

programme.title: परिक्रमा

programme.title: अदृश्य

programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ

programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: డోరా ప్రయాణం
programme.sub-title: A seven-year-old courageous girl, Dora, embarks on a trip with her best friend, Boots, in order to find something that interests her
programme.desc: ఏడేళ్ల అమ్మాయి డోరా తనకు ఆసక్తి ఉన్నదాన్ని కనుగొనడానికి తన స్నేహితుడు బూట్స్‌తో కలిసి విహారయాత్రకు బయలుదేరుతుంది.

programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: ओमी नंबर 1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life

programme.title: जय जगन्नाथ
programme.sub-title: The host shines light on the annual chariot procession held in the honour of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, which is attended by numerous devotees from all over the country
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता ओडिशा के पुरी में भगवान जगन्नाथ की स्तुति में आयोजित वार्षिक रथ यात्रा पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जिसमें देश भर से बड़ी संख्या में भक्त शामिल होते हैं।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: चीता: द मासाई ब्रदरहुड
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the Tana Bora, an alliance of five cheetahs who have grown into a formidable hunting unit that takes down large prey and survives super predators of the savannah
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता पांच चीतों का समूह ताना बोरा के बारे में बताते हैं जो झुंड में शिकार करने के रूप में विकसित होने और बड़े शिकारों को मारना दिखाते और महाशिकारियों से भी बच निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: Glorious Grasslands
programme.desc: Like a sea of grass, the savannah, prairie and meadows are among the most productive habitats on Earth, housing some of the greatest concentrations of big game and dramatic interactions between predator and prey.

programme.title: वाइल्ड बैटलग्राउंड
programme.sub-title: Animals face intense challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: The filmmaker provides insights into some of the unique characteristics of various predatory animals while focusing on their survival instincts.

programme.title: हिप्पोस आफ्टर डार्क
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता रात के समय एक खूंखार बैल के संरक्षण में शेरों के एक समूह और दरियाई घोड़ों के एक झुंड के बीच चरम शक्ति-खेल और अस्तित्व के लिए संघर्ष को फिल्म में दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: औसी स्नेक रैंगलर्स
programme.sub-title: An elusive red-bellied black snake wanders on the outskirts of Sydney as a coastal carpet python struggles inside a drainpipe
programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ, ऑस्ट्रेलियाई घरों में छिपे दुनिया के सबसे घातक सांपों में से कुछ को पकड़ने की कोशिश में जीवन को दाँव पर लगा कर खतरनाक स्थितियों का सामना करते हैं।.

programme.title: औसी स्नेक रैंगलर्स
programme.sub-title: Experts encounter life-threatening situations as they try to catch some of the world's deadliest snakes hiding in Australian homes
programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ, ऑस्ट्रेलियाई घरों में छिपे दुनिया के सबसे घातक सांपों में से कुछ को पकड़ने की कोशिश में जीवन को दाँव पर लगा कर खतरनाक स्थितियों का सामना करते हैं।.

programme.title: चाइनाज़ वाइल्ड सीक्रेटस
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: द सीक्रेट लाइफ ऑफ द हर्मिट क्रैब
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker dives into the life cycle of hermit crabs in Guadeloupe as they embark on their 3 km migration journey to release their eggs into the ocean
programme.desc: फिल्मकार ग्वाडेलूप में एकांत केकड़ों के जीवन चक्र में गहराई से उतरते हैं, जब वे अपने अंडे समुद्र में छोड़ने के लिए 3 किमी की यात्रा करते हैं।.

programme.title: ऐन्टलोप अन्संग हीरोज़ ऑफ द प्लेन
programme.desc: Antelope Unsung Heroes Of The Plain.

programme.title: फियर ऑन द सवाना
programme.sub-title: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived; fear overtook the park
programme.desc: अधिकारियों ने एक पुनर्वासित राष्ट्रीय उद्यान में, जहाँ केवल शाकाहारी जानवर रहते थे, शेरों को छोड़ दिया, जिससे पूरे उद्यान में डर फैल गया।.

programme.title: डॉग्स इन द लैंड ऑफ लायंस
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker follows the extraordinary journey of closely-bonded wild dogs in Zimbabwe, capturing their tender moments to wild hunting
programme.desc: फिल्मकार, जिम्बाब्वे में घनिष्ठ रूप से एक-दूसरे से जुड़े जंगली कुत्तों की अद्भुत यात्रा का वर्णन करते हैं, तथा शिकार के दौरान उनके कोमल क्षणों को कैमरा में कैद करते हैं।.

programme.title: स्नो लेपर्ड्स विथ डॅन ओ'नील
programme.sub-title: Prowl the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard
programme.desc: Dan O'Neill, a biologist and naturalist, travels to Central Asia in an attempt to build a research centre and study the snow leopard.

programme.title: ग्लेडियेटर्स
programme.sub-title: Battles of the wild include territorial brawl between lions and elephants, ants raiding on a termite mould and a honey badger's face-off with a snake
programme.desc: चार अनोखे पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों में जीवन जीने के संघर्षों पर जानकारी, जानवरों के साम्राज्य में भयंकर प्रतिद्वंद्विता, छोटी चींटियों से लेकर विशाल भालुओं का जीवन संघर्ष।.

programme.title: सर्च ऑफ द किंग कोबरा
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the behavioural characteristics and mating habits of King Cobras through a snake expert, who catches the serpents from people's houses and releases them in uninhabited areas
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता, विशेषज्ञ से किंग कोबरा के व्यवहार संबंधी विशेषताओं और संभोग की आदतों के बारे में जानते हैं, जो घरों से साँपों को पकड़ उन्हें निर्जन क्षेत्रों में छोड़ देता है।.

programme.title: विबोरस डे ला पेनिनसुला इबेरिका
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the true nature and behaviour of highly misunderstood creatures known as the venomous vipers that inhabit the Iberian Peninsula
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार इबेरियन प्रायद्वीप में रहने वाले विषैले वाइपर नामक अत्यधिक गलत समझे जाने वाले जीवों की वास्तविक प्रकृति और व्यवहार पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: रेनफॉरेस्ट रीवाइल्ड
programme.desc: Rainforest Rewild.

programme.title: टाइग्रेस ब्लड
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of four tigresses in Central India who are rewriting the rules of how a tiger pack survives and hunts
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार मध्य भारत में चार बाघिनों के जीवन की पड़ताल करते हैं जो बाघों के झुंड के जीवित रहने और शिकार करने के नियमों को फिर से लिख रहे हैं।.

programme.title: लाइफ ऑफ अ प्रेडेटर
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: वुल्व्स: पावर ऑफ द पैक
programme.sub-title: From the Arctic tundra to the Great Plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire Northern Hemisphere; wolves are icons of the wilderness and spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: आर्कटिक टुंड्रा से लेकर विशाल मैदानों तक, भेड़ियों का साम्राज्य पूरे उत्तरी गोलार्ध में फैला हुआ है। वे जंगली दुनिया के प्रतीक हैं--ऐसे अद्भुत जीव, जिनका जीवन और मरण संघर्ष से ही जुड़ा होता है।.

programme.title: एनिमल्स एट नाइट
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: यूरोप्स अमेज़न
programme.sub-title: A journey of 750 km down the Drava river, starting from the river's Alpine origins and ending at its Pannonian Basin outlet
programme.desc: द्रावा और डेन्यूब नदियों के संगम पर स्थित एक वेटलैंड इकोसिस्टम 'आयरन कर्टेन' के पीछे छिपा हुआ है और अब तक ज़्यादातर लोगों की नज़र से दूर रहा है।.

programme.title: ब्रदरहुड ऑफ लायन्स
programme.sub-title: Five male lion cubs compete with each other while hunting their prey, leading to their rise to reign in the territory, thereby complicating the family ties
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार केन्या के मसाई मारा रिजर्व में रहने वाले पाँच युवा शेरों के जीवन पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, साथ ही वे उनके द्वारा सामना किए जा रहे शिकार और आवास का नुकसान जैसे कई खतरों पर भी प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: नैचरल बॉर्न मॉन्सटर्स
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: हिप्पो किंग
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the life, challenges and survival tactics of an old hippo bull from the Luangwa valley of Zambia
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार जाम्बिया की लुआंगवा घाटी के एक बूढ़े हिप्पो बैल के जीवन, चुनौतियों और अस्तित्व की रणनीति की पड़ताल करते हैं।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड श्रीलंका
programme.sub-title: The central highlands of Sri Lanka is a region of rich biodiversity and therefore acts as a home to numerous unique flora and fauna
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार श्रीलंका के सर्वाधिक जैविक विविधता वाले पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र को उजागर करते हैं, जो तेंदुए और विशाल समुद्री जीवों जैसे सर्वाधिक धूर्त और क्रूर जानवरों से भरा पड़ा है।.

programme.title: नाइट ऑन अर्थ: अफ्रीका
programme.sub-title: Explore the incredible odyssey of a baby elephant and his family traveling hundreds of kilometers through the wildest and most desolate landscapes of Sub-Saharan Africa
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार अफ़्रीकी सवाना में शाम ढलने के बाद विभिन्न जानवरों के मनोरम रात्रिकालीन रोमांचों के बारे में जानने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: द टीथ ऑफ द सवाना
programme.desc: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there.

programme.title: लायन्स व्हर्सेस हायनाज
programme.sub-title: Lioness and hyena mothers need to get their helpless offspring through their first tough months of life. However, they both make use of completely contrasting strategies in order to achieve it
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार शेरों और लकड़बग्घों के व्यवहार का परीक्षण करते हैं तथा उनकी कथित प्रतिद्वंद्विता के बारे में पूर्वधारणाओं को चुनौती देते हैं।.

programme.title: बिग कैट्स ऑफ द सेरेन्गेटी
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the life of a lion and cheetah family as they struggle to survive amidst climate change in Serengeti
programme.desc: फिल्मकार उन शेर और चीता के परिवार के जीवन पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जो सेरेन्गेटी में जलवायु परिवर्तन के बीच जीवित रहने के लिए संघर्ष करते हैं।.

programme.title: बिग कैट टेल्स
programme.sub-title: A dispersed Marsh Pride faces weakened protection from the six male warrior lions whilst Kabibi and Cloudy Eye desperately hunt to sustain their hungry new cubs
programme.desc: टीम बड़ी बिल्लियों की विभिन्न प्रजातियों के जीवन- संघर्ष का दस्तावेजीकरण करती है, जो शिकार करने, क्षेत्रों की रक्षा करने और जंगल में बच्चों को पालने का प्रयास करती हैं।.

programme.title: राइज़ ऑफ जैगुआर्स
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives of the elusive jaguars, highlighting their intelligence and hunting prowess that make them one of the most formidable predators in the world.

programme.title: गोल्डन ईगल: कॉल ऑफ़ द वाइल्ड
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: वाइल्ड कश्मीर
programme.desc: Wild Kashmir.

programme.title: बैटल ऑफ दी अल्फ़ाज़
programme.sub-title: In Madagascar, the animals battle in an isolated tropical forest. Female lemurs carry their offspring for protection and hold on for dear life with panther chameleons
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पशु साम्राज्य की विभिन्न प्रजातियों के बीच संघर्ष का दस्तावेजीकरण करते हैं और प्रतिद्वंद्विता के पीछे के उद्देश्यों को समझने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

programme.title: बिग कैट्स स्माल वर्ल्ड
programme.sub-title: While the winter floods tire Melelo's pride, elsewhere, Sephiri encounters something scary that puts her in a critical position
programme.desc: तीन बिल्ली परिवार बोत्सवाना की गोमोती नदी को अपना घर बनाते है जहां अपनी जगह बनाने के लिए वह शिकारियों और प्रतिद्वंद्वियों को मात देने के लिए अपने कौशल का उपयोग करते हैं।.

programme.title: नेचर्स फास्ट अटैक्स
programme.sub-title: In the age-old battle between predator and prey, subterfuge and speed can be a case of life or death for many animals from tigers to cuttlefish
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता प्रकृति के बड़े शिकारियों को फिल्माने के लिए दुनिया की यात्रा करते हैं क्योंकि वे अपने शिकार का पीछा करने और हमला करने के लिए अपनी गति और चपलता का उपयोग करते हैं।.

programme.title: सर्वाइविंग ऑस्ट्रेलिया
programme.sub-title: Survivors recount incidents of being lost in the Australian wilderness, getting stuck underground and having close encounters with some of the country's deadliest inhabitants
programme.desc: जीवित बचे लोग ऑस्ट्रेलिया के सुदूर इलाकों से अपने भयावह पलायन की कहानियाँ सुनाते हैं, जबकि विशेषज्ञ आम मिथकों को तोड़ते हुए जीवित रहने के लिए आवश्यक व्यावहारिक रणनीतियाँ बताते हैं।.

programme.title: राइज़ ऑफ जैगुआर्स
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives of the elusive jaguars, highlighting their intelligence and hunting prowess that make them one of the top predators in the world.

programme.title: इटली: द लास्ट वाइल्डरनेस इयर 1
programme.sub-title: Explore the life of a family of brown bears in a year, the special characteristics of the rutting season of Roe Deer in the Mountains of Central Italy, and the migration of salamanders in autumn
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता यूरोप के दिल, डेन्यूब नदी के किनारे के जंगलों के पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में पनप रहे अद्वितीय वन्यजीव आवास के बारे में गहराई से जानते हैं।.

programme.title: बिग कैट्स: एन अमेजिंग एनिमल फ़ैमिली
programme.sub-title: Zoologist Patrick Aryee comes within a whisker of some of Earth's most majestic predators as he embarks on a remarkable journey through the feline family tree
programme.desc: शिकारी बिल्लियों की 37 अलग-अलग प्रजातियाँ हर जंगली इलाके पर राज करती हैं। एक जीवविज्ञानी उनकी सफलता और उनके विविध वंशवृक्ष का पता लगाते हैं।.

programme.title: रिवर मॉन्स्टर्स
programme.sub-title: Jeremy Wade sets out to investigate a sea monster that has washed up on an English beach. His journey takes him to the ice sheets of Greenland and the fjords of Norway
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता जो एक जीवविज्ञानी और मछुआरा हैं, वे कई मिथकों को खत्म करने और उनसे जुड़ी खौफ़नाक कहानियों को जानने के लिए मीठे पानी के रहस्यों और स्थानीय लोककथाओं की पड़ताल करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Jeremy Wade,Vic Hislop,David Buckmeier,Mark Spitzer,Tim Mousseau,Daniel Göz

programme.title: हिप्पोस आफ्टर डार्क
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता रात के समय एक खूंखार बैल के संरक्षण में शेरों के एक समूह और दरियाई घोड़ों के एक झुंड के बीच चरम शक्ति-खेल और अस्तित्व के लिए संघर्ष को फिल्म में दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: Glorious Grasslands
programme.desc: Like a sea of grass, the savannah, prairie and meadows are among the most productive habitats on Earth, housing some of the greatest concentrations of big game and dramatic interactions between predator and prey.

programme.title: वाइल्ड बैटलग्राउंड
programme.sub-title: Animals face intense challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: The filmmaker provides insights into some of the unique characteristics of various predatory animals while focusing on their survival instincts.

programme.title: वाइल्ड वाइल्ड बंच
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers detailed insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार विविध वन्यजीवों के व्यवहारिक और शारीरिक पहलुओं के साथ-साथ जीवित रहने और अपने शिकार को हराने के लिए उनके द्वारा अपनाई जाने वाली रणनीतियों पर भी प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: वैली ऑफ फ्लड एण्ड फ़ायर
programme.sub-title: The end of November marks the finish of one of the toughest dry seasons on record, and triggers a transition from parched wilderness to lush wetland
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार लुआंगवा घाटी के नाटकीय मौसमी परिवर्तनों को फिल्माते हैं, जहां बारिश परिदृश्य को वन्य जीवन और हरे-भरे वनस्पतियों से भरे एक समृद्ध पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में बदल देती है।.

programme.title: ए गेम ऑफ लेपर्ड थ्रोन्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the leopard who fiercely reigns as the queen of the territory, facing perils and also mother to eight cubs
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार दक्षिण अफ्रीका के साबी सैंड्स गेम रिजर्व में तेंदुओं के बीच वर्चस्व की लड़ाई पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जब उनकी 12 साल की रानी अब इस दुनिया में नहीं रही।.

programme.title: बिग कैट्स: एन अमेजिंग एनिमल फ़ैमिली
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee begins his American adventure in the tangled jungles of Central America, where he meets the ocelot dynasty

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: पारम्परिक लोकगीत
programme.sub-title: Traditional folk songs from diverse Indian regions come alive through soulful performances, celebrating cultural heritage with rich melodies and authentic instruments
programme.desc: विविध भारतीय क्षेत्रों के पारंपरिक लोकगीत भावपूर्ण प्रदर्शनों के माध्यम से जीवंत हो उठते हैं, समृद्ध धुनों और प्रामाणिक वाद्ययंत्रों के साथ सांस्कृतिक विरासत का जश्न मनाते हैं।.

programme.title: काकभुशुण्डि रामायण
programme.sub-title: The Ramayana, one of the greatest epics in the history of humankind and the basis of Indian core values, ideals and lifestyle, shows Rama's journey as his virtue triumphs over evil
programme.desc: रामायण, मानव जाति के इतिहास में सबसे महान महाकाव्यों में से एक है तथा भारतीय मूल्यों, आदर्शों और जीवनशैली का आधार है, जो राम की यात्रा को दर्शाते हैं जिसमें उनके सद्गुणों ने बुराई पर विजय प्राप्त की।.

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारत और दुनिया भर के मौसम से संबंधित नवीनतम समाचार प्रस्तुत करते हैं और जलवायु में संभावित परिवर्तनों के बारे में भविष्यवाणियाँ करते हैं।.

programme.title: किसान यात्रा
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the latest updates and significant developments concerning the agriculture sector of the country
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता देश के कृषि क्षेत्र से संबंधित नवीनतम अपडेट और महत्वपूर्ण विकास के बारे में विस्तार से बताते हैं।.

programme.title: मौसम खबर
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news and updates regarding the weather in India and around the world and makes predictions about the possible changes in the climate
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारत और दुनिया भर के मौसम से संबंधित नवीनतम समाचार प्रस्तुत करते हैं और जलवायु में संभावित परिवर्तनों के बारे में भविष्यवाणियाँ करते हैं।.

programme.title: हैलो किसान
programme.sub-title: The host entertains phone calls from viewers who ask questions and seek solutions from agricultural experts on various issues related to farming and animal husbandry
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता विभिन्न कृषि विषयों पर विशेषज्ञों के साथ बातचीत करते हैं, और वे खेती के विभिन्न मुद्दों से संबंधित दर्शकों के प्रश्नों का उत्तर देते हैं।.

programme.title: ग्रामीण शोधशालाएँ
programme.sub-title: The host uncovers how rural farmers pioneer advanced research methods, transforming traditional agriculture into a high-tech, sustainable industry
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता बताते हैं, कि किस प्रकार ग्रामीण किसान उन्नत अनुसंधान विधियों का उपयोग कर पारंपरिक कृषि को एक उच्च तकनीक, टिकाऊ उद्योग में परिवर्तित कर रहे हैं।.

programme.title: योगऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Baba Ramdev, a spiritual leader, delivers a discourse on spirituality and demonstrates various yoga asanas that enable oneself to lead a healthy and active lifestyle
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु बाबा रामदेव आध्यात्मिकता पर प्रवचन देते हैं और विभिन्न योग आसनों का प्रदर्शन करते हैं जो स्वस्थ और सक्रिय जीवनशैली जीने में सक्षम बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: जतिन अग्रवाल जी
programme.sub-title: Jatin Agrawal Ji sings a series of soulful and melodious devotional songs in praise of the Almighty to foster a deep spiritual connection for the listeners
programme.desc: जतिन अग्रवाल जी सर्वशक्तिमान की स्तुति में हृदयस्पर्शी और मधुर भक्ति गीतों की एक श्रृंखला प्रस्तुत करते हैं, ताकि श्रोताओं के भीतर आध्यात्मिक जुड़ाव स्थापित हो सके।.

programme.title: महावीर शर्मा जी
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs, hymns and sacred chants in praise of the Almighty is played back-to-back
programme.desc: ईश्वर की स्तुति में भक्ति गीतों, भजनों और पवित्र मंत्रों का व्यापक संकलन लगातार प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: कृषण भैया सिरसा वाले
programme.sub-title: Bhaiya Krishan Das, a spiritual adept, reads passages and sacred verses from a religious text, explains their meaning and further sings hymns with the devotees
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु भैया कृष्ण दास धार्मिक ग्रंथों से कुछ अंश और पवित्र श्लोक पढ़ते हुए उनका अर्थ समझाते हैं और भक्तों के साथ भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.title: स्वामी हरि चैतन्य महाप्रभु जी
programme.sub-title: Swami Hari Chaitanya ji delivers a discourse on various religious aspects to a gathering of devotees, inspiring them to follow the principles of spirituality
programme.desc: स्वामी हरि चैतन्य जी भक्तों के एक समूह को विभिन्न धार्मिक पहलुओं पर प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा उन्हें आध्यात्मिकता के सिद्धांतों का पालन करने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।.

programme.title: इस्कॉन
programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees perform rituals and chant sacred verses in praise of Lord Krishna at the ISKCON Temple in India
programme.desc: भारत में इस्कॉन मंदिर में हिंदू पुजारी और भक्त भगवान कृष्ण की स्तुति में अनुष्ठान करते हैं और पवित्र श्लोकों का जाप करते हैं।.

programme.title: मिनरल गुरु
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: संत रामपाल जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Sant Rampal Ji Maharaj delivers a discourse based on sacred religious scriptures and imparts their significance among the followers
programme.desc: संत रामपाल जी महाराज पवित्र धार्मिक ग्रंथों पर आधारित प्रवचन देते हैं और अनुयायियों के बीच उनका महत्व बताते हैं।.

programme.title: जीसस कॉल
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders representing the church lead a session of prayer, after which devotees share their holistic experiences and the miracles they have witnessed
programme.desc: चर्च का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले धार्मिक गुरु एक प्रार्थना सत्र का नेतृत्व करते हैं, जिसके बाद अनुयायी अपने समग्र अनुभव और अपने द्वारा देखे गए चमत्कारों को साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: राम नारायण राम
programme.sub-title: The host engages in illuminating dialogues with spiritual leaders, gaining vital knowledge about various religious concepts
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता आध्यात्मिक गुरुओं के साथ ज्ञानवर्धक संवाद में संलग्न होते हैं, तथा विभिन्न धार्मिक अवधारणाओं के बारे में महत्वपूर्ण ज्ञान प्राप्त करते हैं।.

programme.title: भविष्य दर्पण
programme.sub-title: An astrologer reads the position of celestial objects and provides comprehensive predictions of the future for 12 zodiac signs
programme.desc: एक ज्योतिषी आकाशीय पिंडों की स्थिति को पढ़ते हैं और बारह राशियों के भविष्य के बारे में विस्तार से भविष्यवाणी करते हैं।.

programme.title: बाला जी सरकार
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages the followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भाग्योदय
programme.sub-title: An astrology expert interprets celestial movements to provide insights into personalities, relationships and life events
programme.desc: एक ज्योतिष विशेषज्ञ व्यक्तित्व, रिश्तों और जीवन की घटनाओं के बारे में अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करने के लिए ग्रह-गोचरों की गतिविधियों की व्याख्या करते हैं।.

programme.title: காதலி
programme.sub-title: Deivanai is an innocent rural girl who has carried a flame for her childhood sweetheart, Gopal, all her life. However, when Gopal leaves for college he falls in love with a fellow student
programme.desc: ஒரு அப்பாவி கிராமத்துப் பெண்ணான தெய்வானை, சிறுவயது முதல் கோபால் மீது அவள் ஆழ்ந்த காதல் கொண்டிருக்கிறாள், ஆனால், கல்லூரிக்குச் செல்லும் கோபால், அங்குள்ள சக மாணவி ஒருவரைக் காதலிக்கத் தொடங்குகிறான்.

programme.title: மேட்டுப்பட்டி மிராசு
programme.sub-title: Radha and Durai's love faces strong resistance from Radha's nephew, Shiva. Tensions rise when Shiva's father discloses a shocking truth
programme.desc: ராதா-துரையின் காதலை சிவா எதிர்க்கும் போது, சிவாவின் தந்தை அதிர்ச்சியூட்டும் உண்மையை வெளிப்படுத்தி பதற்றம் அதிகரிக்கிறது.

programme.title: குவாகுவா வாத்துக்கல்
programme.sub-title: Murugan and his wife, Laxmi, go to the city to make a new beginning. However, they are soon duped by their new friend Dharmalingam, who takes advantage of their naïveté
programme.desc: நகரத்திற்கு வரும் முருகன் மேலும் மனைவி லட்சுமியின் அப்பாவித்தனத்தை பயன்படுத்தி கொண்டு அவர்களை தர்மலிங்கம் ஏமாற்றுகிறான்.

programme.title: கனம் கோர்ட்டார் அவர்களே
programme.sub-title: Rookie lawyer Bhaskar gets close to his boss, Desikachari's family. However, when murder strikes, he's in a race to clear his mentor's name
programme.desc: தனது குருவான தேசிகாச்சாரி மீதுள்ள பொய்யான குற்றச்சாட்டை துடைத்து, அவர் நிரபராதியென நிரூபிக்க முயலும் வழக்கறிஞர் பாஸ்கர்.

credits.actor: Sathyaraj (Jayabhaskar),Ambika Viji (Seetha),S. S. Chandran (Desikachari),Silk Smitha (Nirosha),Srividya (Pankajam),Janagaraj (Baski's mentor),Captain Raju (Badesa),Pratap Pothen

programme.title: சுகமான ராகங்கள்
programme.sub-title: An honest police officer is falsely implicated in a rape case after he initiates a murder investigation against a notorious gangster. With his reputation at stake, the officer strives for justice
programme.desc: ஒரு தாதாவுக்கு எதிராக கொலை விசாரணையை தொடங்கியபின், தன் மீது போடப்பட்ட கற்பழிப்பு வழக்கிலிருந்து வெளிவர போராடும் போலீஸ்.

programme.desc: சவுதி அரேபியாவிற்கு செல்லும் அஸ்வதி, பணியிடத்தில் சித்திரவதைகளை சமாளிக்க முடியாமல் அங்கிருந்து தப்ப முயல்கிறாள்.

programme.title: అన్నమాచార్య పాదర్చన
programme.sub-title: A curated a collection of harmonious devotional hymns dedicated to Lord Venkateswara, praising the divine avatar of Vishnu
programme.desc: విష్ణుమూర్తి దివ్య అవతారాన్ని స్తుతిస్తూ, వెంకటేశ్వరుడికి అంకితం చేయబడిన శ్రావ్యమైన భక్తి స్తోత్రాల సమాహారం.

programme.title: ద్వారకా తిరుమల సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: Devotional hymns and prayers dedicated to Lord Venkateswara are beautifully presented, creating a peaceful atmosphere for worshippers and helping them connect with their faith
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ సంగీతకారులు స్వరపరచిన, ప్రముఖ గాయకులు ఆలపించిన శ్రీ వేంకటేశ్వర స్వామి భక్తి గీతాల సమగ్ర సంకలనం.

programme.title: వందేమాతరం సాంగ్
programme.sub-title: A compilation of patriotic songs glorifying the greatness and unity of India and performed by various artists is played back to back
programme.desc: భారతదేశ గొప్పతనాన్ని మరియు ఐక్యతను కీర్తిస్తూ వివిధ కళాకారులు ప్రదర్శించే దేశభక్తి గీతాల త్వరితగతిన ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: నాదస్వరం
programme.sub-title: Professional musicians play classical compositions on the nadaswaram, a traditional South Indian wind instrument, and enthrall the viewers
programme.desc: ప్రొఫెషనల్ సంగీతకారులు ప్రేక్షకులను అలరించడానికి నాదస్వరం అనే పవన వాయిద్యంలో శాస్త్రీయ సంగీతాన్ని వాయిస్తారు.

programme.title: డివోషనల్ సాంగ్స్
programme.sub-title: A religious leader and devotees sing songs to praise the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, భక్తులు భగవంతుని బోధనలను స్తుతించడానికి పాటలు పాడతారు, ఆధ్యాత్మికత మార్గాన్ని తీసుకోమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: అర్చన
programme.sub-title: Religious priests and devotees offer prayers and perform sacred rituals to seek the blessings of the Almighty at a place of worship
programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒక పుణ్యక్షేత్రంలో భగవంతుడి కృపాకటాక్షలను కోరుతూ ఆచార వ్యవహారాలతో ప్రత్యేక పూజలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: పసిడిపంటలు

programme.title: ரகசிய கேள்விகள்
programme.sub-title: Renowned sexologist Dr Kamaraj provides expert advice on issues like impotency and erectile dysfunction, while offering treatment recommendations tailored to individual needs
programme.desc: பாலியல் நிபுணர் டாக்டர் காமராஜ்,ஆண்மைக்குறைவு-விறைப்புத்தன்மை பிரச்சினைகளில் ஆலோசனைகளை வழங்கி, பரிந்துரைகளை அளிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: நெஞ்சில் ஒரு ஆலயம்,நெஞ்சில் ஒரே ஆலயம்
programme.sub-title: Murali pursues a career as a cancer doctor after his lover marries another. Things take a turn when he ends up treating a man who happens to be his former lover's husband
programme.desc: காதலி வேறொருவரை மணந்த பின் மருத்துவராக பணிபுரியும் முரளி,காதலியின் கணவருக்கு சிகிச்சை அளிக்கும்போது விஷயங்கள் மாறுகிறது.

credits.actor: Kalyan Kumar,Devika,Aachi Manorama,R. Muthuraman,Nagesh,V.S. Raghavan,Kutty Padmini,Sivakami

programme.title: மீசை மாதவன்
programme.sub-title: A doctor fails to save the life of a street vendor's son, so the distraught father, who is also a musician, kidnaps the doctor's son and flees the city
programme.desc: தெரு வியாபாரியின் மகனின் உயிரை காப்பாற்ற மருத்துவர் தோல்வியுற்றதில்,தந்தையான இசைக்கலைஞர் மருத்துவரின் மகனை கடத்துகிறார்.

programme.title: அய்யா வழி சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Devotional artists and singers perform soulful hymns, celebrating Ayya Vaikundar, a 19th-century visionary and social reformer, inspiring faith and social change
programme.desc: பக்திப் பாடகர்கள் 19 ஆம் நூற்றாண்டின் தொலைநோக்கு பார்வையாளரான அய்யா வைகுண்டரைக் கொண்டாடி, பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders along with devotees recite morning prayers, conduct rituals and sing devotional songs in praise of various Hindu deities
programme.desc: மத தலைவர்கள் பக்தர்களுடன் காலை பிரார்த்தனைகளை ஓதி, சடங்குகளை நடத்தி, இந்து தெய்வங்களை போற்றி பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: இண்டியா சாங்க்
programme.sub-title: A group of experienced artists, musicians and singers perform a special patriotic song depicting the beauty, traditions and cultures of India
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் அழகு, மரபுகள் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரங்களை சித்தரிக்கும் ஒரு சிறப்பு தேசபக்தி பாடலை நிகழ்த்தும் பாடகர்கள் குழு.

programme.title: கந்த சஷ்டி கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A melodious rendering of a hymn composed in praise of Lord Murugan is played in order to invoke the spirit of devotion
programme.desc: பக்தி உணர்வைத் தூண்டும் வகையில், முருகப் பெருமானைப் புகழ்ந்து இயற்றப்பட்ட ஒரு பாடலின் மெல்லிசைப் பாடல் இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: ஆலயதர்சனம்

programme.desc: நாட்டின் பல கோயில்களின் வரலாறு மற்றும் மத முக்கியத்துவம் பற்றிய தகவல்களை தொகுப்பாளர் பக்தர்களுக்கு பகிர்ந்து கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: வெற்றிப்படிக்கட்டு

programme.desc: பொதுமக்களுக்கு ஊக்கமளிக்கும் வகையில் நுண்ணறிவுமிக்க உரையை ஆற்றும் பிரபல தொழிலதிபரும் அரசியல்வாதியுமான எச் வசந்தகுமார்.

programme.desc: தமிழ் திரைத்துறையில் உள்ள நடிகர்கள் மற்றும் தொழில்நுட்ப வல்லுநர்கள் அவர்களின் பயணங்கள்-அனுபவங்களைப் பற்றி பேசுகின்றனர்.

programme.title: தெய்வீக வழிபாடு
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the key significance of Hinduism and explains how one can live a pious life by following its precepts
programme.desc: இந்து மதத்தின் முக்கியத்துவத்தை விளக்கி, அதன் விதிகளை பின்பற்றுவதன் மூலம் பக்தியுடன் வாழ்வது குறித்து பேசும் மத தலைவர்.

programme.title: இண்டியா சாங்க்

programme.title: கந்த சஷ்டி கவசம்

programme.title: ஆலயதர்சனம்
