programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively
programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்

programme.title: फेमस
programme.sub-title: Radhe looks up to Kadak Singh, a local politician, but holds a grudge against his partner, Ram Tripathi. However, things reach a boiling point when Tripathi sets his sights on Radhe's wife, Lalli
programme.desc: चंबल में रहने वाला राधे एक कुख्यात गैंगस्टर, कडक सिंह का आदर करता है। हालांकि, कड़क सिंह के लिए काम करने वाला राजनेता, त्रिपाठी जब राधे की पत्नी पर बुरी नज़र डालता है तब राधे लड़ने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Jimmy Sheirgill (Radhe Shyam),Shriya Saran (Lalli),Kay Kay Menon (Kadak Singh),Pankaj Tripathi (Ram Vijay Tripathi),Jackie Shroff (Shambhu Singh),Mahie Gill (Teacher Rozy)

programme.title: देह्रादुन् दिअर्य्
programme.desc: Anshul, an ordinary man, falls in love with Preeti, a politician's daughter. Things take a turn when Preeti's brothers disapprove of the relationship and commit a crime in order to end it.

credits.actor: Adhyayan Suman,Ashwini Kalsekar,Rati Agnihotri,Neelima Azim,Rohit Bakhshi,Ragini Nandwani,Vishal Bhonsle

programme.title: नैना
programme.sub-title: After years of blindness caused by an accident, Naina gets a successful cornea transplant. However, she soon begins to see terrifying visions that prompt her to investigate the source of her sight
programme.desc: एक लड़की दुर्घटना में अपने माता-पिता और अपनी आँखों की रोशनी खो देती है। उसके बड़े होने पर, उसकी रोशनी वापस लाने के लिए उसका ऑपरेशन किया जाता है। नई आँखें मिलने पर, उसे एक अभिशाप भी मिलता है।.

credits.actor: Urmila Matondkar (Niana Shah),Anuj Sawhney (Dr. Samir Patel),Malavika (Khemi),Amardeep Jha (Somabai),Kamini Khanna (Mrs. Shah),Sulabha Arya (Parvati Amma),Morne Botes (Burn Victim),Dinesh Lamba (Rathore),Shweta Konnur (Khemi)

programme.title: साजन की सहेली
programme.sub-title: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl
programme.desc: एक शानदार जीवन जीने और अमीर आदमी से शादी करने कुंती अपने बच्ची को छोड़ देती है।सालों बाद,उसे पता चलता है कि उसके पति का किसी लड़की के साथ अवैध संबंध है लेकिन लड़की के बारे में जानने के बाद हैरान होती है।.

credits.actor: Nutan (Kunti Kumar),Rajendra Kumar (Barrister Avinash Kumar),Rekha (Moon-Moon Dhawan),Vinod Mehra (Anand),Suresh Oberoi,Paintal,Anil Dhawan,Kalpana Iyer

programme.title: सिन्दूर
programme.sub-title: Suspecting an extra-marital affair, Vijay, a professor, abandons his wife, Laxmi. However, years later, when he is hurtled back into Laxmi's life through her adopted daughter, things become clearer
programme.desc: विवाहेतर संबंध के संदेह में, प्रोफेसर विजय, अपनी पत्नी को छोड़ देता है। वर्षों बाद, लक्ष्मी की गोद ली पुत्री के माध्यम से उसके जीवन में वापस आता है, तो चीजें स्पष्ट हो जाती हैं।.

credits.actor: Shashi Kapoor (Professor Vijay Choudhury),Jaya Prada (Laxmi Choudhary),Rishi Kapoor (Kumar),Govinda (Ravi),Neelam (Lalita Kapoor),Jeetendra (Prem Kapoor)

programme.title: बेटा
programme.desc: After the death of his mother, Raju's father re-marries, but his stepmother is only after the family's money. When Raju eventually marries, his wife tries to make him realise what kind of woman his stepmother is.

credits.actor: Anil Kapoor (Raju),Madhuri Dixit (Saraswati),Anupam Kher (Totaram),Akash Khurana (Prem),Aruna Irani (Laxmi Devi),Laxmikant Berde (Pandu Dhondu Bhikaji Rao),Adi Irani (Ramesh),Rita Bhaduri (Neeta)

programme.title: టైగర్ మాఫియా
programme.desc: Tiger Mafia.

programme.title: చీతా: ది మాసాయి బ్రదర్‌హుడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the Tana Bora, an alliance of five cheetahs who have grown into a formidable hunting unit that takes down large prey and survives super predators of the savannah
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఒక శక్తివంతమైన వేట బృందంగా ఎదిగి, పెద్ద వేటను వేటాడిన ఐదు చిరుతల కూటమి, 'టానా బోరా' గురించి వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: గ్లోరియస్ గ్రాస్‌ల్యాండ్స్
programme.desc: Like a sea of grass, the savannah, prairie and meadows are among the most productive habitats on Earth, housing some of the greatest concentrations of big game and dramatic interactions between predator and prey.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బ్యాటిల్ గ్రౌండ్
programme.sub-title: Animals face challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: Different animals use the terrain and their unique attributes to their advantage and defeat their opponents at each location, becoming masters of communication, camouflage, diplomacy, and combat.

programme.title: హిప్పోస్ ఆఫ్టర్ డార్క్
programme.sub-title: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సింహాల అహంకారం, హిప్పోల మంద మధ్య రాత్రి పడుతుండగా భయంకరమైన ఎద్దు రక్షణలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాటాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ఆసీ స్నేక్ రాంగ్లర్స్
programme.sub-title: Chris and Jess head to the outskirts of Sydney, Australia, to capture an elusive red-bellied black snake; a coastal carpet python needs help out of a drainpipe; Stuart and Olivia make a rare find
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: ఆసీ స్నేక్ రాంగ్లర్స్
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: చైనాస్ వైల్డ్ సీక్రెట్స్
programme.sub-title: In southwestern China, towering mountains provide shelter for nearly 2,000 wild giant pandas. Giant Panda National Park is three times the size of Yellowstone and is home to over 10,000 species
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: ది సీక్రెట్ లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ది హెర్మిట్ క్రాబ్
programme.sub-title: Dives into the life cycle of hermit crabs in Guadeloupe as they embark on their migration journey to release their eggs into the ocean
programme.desc: పురాతన ఆచారం ప్రకారం తీరప్రాంతానికి వలసలకు సిద్దమైన పీతలు రాతి భూభాగాలు, దట్టమైన అడవుల గుండా ప్రయాణిస్తాయి.

programme.title: ఆంటెలోప్ అన్‌సంగ్ హీరోస్ ఆఫ్ ది ప్లేన్
programme.desc: Antelope Unsung Heroes Of The Plain.

programme.title: ఫియర్ ఆన్ ది సవన్నా
programme.sub-title: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived, and fear overtook the park
programme.desc: కేవలం శాకాహారులు మాత్రమే నివసించే పునరుద్ధరించబడిన జాతీయ ఉద్యానవనంలో అధికారులు సింహాలను ప్రవేశపెట్టడంతో, ఆ పార్కులో భయం ఆవరిస్తుంది.

programme.title: డాగ్స్ ఇన్ ద ల్యాండ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: We follow the unforgettable journey of a family of wild dogs in Zimbabwe and witness rarely seen behaviour, from tender moments with newborn pups, to the thrills of hunting wildebeest, to close encounters with their greatest enemy - the lion
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, జింబాబ్వేలోని అడవి కుక్కల అసాధారణ ప్రయాణాన్ని అనుసరిస్తూ, అవి వేటాడే సమయంలో సున్నితమైన క్షణాలను సంగ్రహిస్తారు.

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Prowling the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: గ్లాడియేటర్స్
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత నాలుగు పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలలో జీవితాన్ని నిర్వచించే యుద్ధాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, జంతురాజ్యంలో తీవ్రమైన పోటీలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: సర్చ్ ఫర్ ద కింగ్ కోబ్రా
programme.sub-title: Austin Stevens, a photographer and herpetologist, travels to the remote jungles of Southern India in pursuit of the world's largest venomous snake, the king cobra
programme.desc: ఆస్టిన్, ప్రపంచంలోనే అతిపెద్ద విషపూరిత సర్పం కింగ్ కోబ్రా కోసం వెతుకుతూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోని మారుమూల అరణ్యాలకు వెళతాడు.

programme.title: ఐబీరియన్ వైపర్స్
programme.sub-title: Exploring the behaviour, unique characteristics, and survival strategies of venomous vipers in the Iberian Peninsula
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఐబీరియన్ ద్వీపకల్పంలో నివసించే అత్యంత విషపూరితమైన వైపర్‌ల ప్రవర్తన, లక్షణాలు, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: రెయిన్‌ఫారెస్ట్ రివిల్డ్
programme.desc: Rainforest Rewild.

programme.title: టైగ్రెస్ బ్లడ్
programme.sub-title: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మధ్య భారతదేశంలోని నాలుగు పులుల జీవితాలను అన్వేషించారు, అవి పులి ప్యాక్ ఎలా జీవించి వేటాడుతుంది.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్: పవర్ ఆఫ్ ది ప్యాక్
programme.sub-title: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: యానిమల్స్ ఎట్ నైట్
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: యూరప్స్ అమెజాన్
programme.sub-title: Going on a 750km journey down the Drava river, starting with the current's Alpine origins to its delta in the Pannonian Basin
programme.desc: ద్రావా, డాన్యూబ్ నదుల సంగమ స్థానంలో నెలకొని ఉన్న చిత్తడి నేల పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థ చాలా వరకు ఇనుప తెర వెనుక దాగి ఉంది.

programme.title: బ్రదర్‌హుడ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: Five male lion cubs compete with each other while hunting their prey, but their family ties become increasingly complicated as they make their gradual rise to reign in the territory
programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.sub-title: Sean Duggan travels to Thailand to investigate the giant snakehead fish in its native habitat. Sean's expedition takes him from Thailand to snakehead-infested Arkansas to see if this killer fish can be stopped
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: ది హిప్పో కింగ్
programme.sub-title: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఒక పెద్ద హిప్పో బుల్ నిజమైన స్వభావం,అంతగా తెలియని జీవితంపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Wild Sri Lanka
programme.sub-title: Many species unique to Sri Lanka live nowhere except its central highlands, but the cloud forests are threatened by the tea trade
programme.desc: For its size, Sri Lanka is one of the most biologically diverse places on Earth.

programme.title: నైట్ ఆన్ ఎర్త్: ఆఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Exploring the incredible odyssey and nocturnal adventures of African elephants, who must migrate across wild and dangerous terrain in order to survive
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఆఫ్రికన్ సవన్నాలో సంధ్యా సమయం తర్వాత వివిధ జంతువుల ఆకర్షణీయమైన రాత్రిపూట సాహసాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: ది టీత్ ఆఫ్ ది సవన్నా
programme.sub-title: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there
programme.desc: ఆఫ్రికా అరణ్యాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, అక్కడ నివసించే వివిధ జీవజాతుల గురించి తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: లయన్స్ వర్సెస్ హైనాస్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the misunderstood rivalry between lions and hyenas, shedding light on their conflict and offering new insights into their complex relationship
programme.desc: చిత్రదర్శకుడు ఎన్నో ఏళ్లుగా ప్రజలు తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుంటున్న సింహాలు, హైనాల మధ్య జరిగే సంఘర్షణ గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ ఆఫ్ ద సెరెంగేటి
programme.sub-title: Cameras reveal the last secrets of Africa's largest wild lions by following two prides
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సెరెంగేటిలో వాతావరణ మార్పుల మధ్య మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడుతున్న సింహం, చిరుత జాతుల జీవితాల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: A dispersed Marsh Pride faces weakened protection from the six male warrior lions. Plus, a cheetah works tirelessly to raise her three new cubs
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: రైజ్ ఆఫ్ జాగ్వర్స్
programme.desc: Rise Of Jaguars.

programme.title: గోల్డెన్ ఈగిల్: కాల్ ఆఫ్ ది వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Following the young bird on an adventurous odyssey from tender parental care to independence and on its challenging search for a territory of its own
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: Wild Kashmir
programme.desc: Wild Kashmir.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ స్మాల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted when the winter floods arrive, and witness a scary encounter that gives leopard mum Sephiri a decision to make
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: నేచర్స్ ఫాస్ట్ ఎటాక్స్
programme.sub-title: In the battle between predator and prey, camouflage and speed often make the difference between life and death, as some of the fastest animals can strike and kill in the blink of an eye
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు తమవేగాన్ని, చురుకుదనాన్ని ఉపయోగించి తమ ఎరను పట్టుకునే వేటాడే జంతువులను చూపడానికి ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఆస్ట్రేలియా
programme.sub-title: Survivors recount incidents of being lost in the Australian wilderness, getting stuck underground, being caught in landslides, and having close encounters with some of the country's deadliest inhabitants

programme.sub-title: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సింహాల అహంకారం, హిప్పోల మంద మధ్య రాత్రి పడుతుండగా భయంకరమైన ఎద్దు రక్షణలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాటాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: గ్లోరియస్ గ్రాస్‌ల్యాండ్స్
programme.desc: Like a sea of grass, the savannah, prairie and meadows are among the most productive habitats on Earth, housing some of the greatest concentrations of big game and dramatic interactions between predator and prey.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బ్యాటిల్ గ్రౌండ్
programme.sub-title: Animals face challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: Different animals use the terrain and their unique attributes to their advantage and defeat their opponents at each location, becoming masters of communication, camouflage, diplomacy, and combat.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: వ్యాలీ ఆఫ్ ఫ్లడ్ అండ్ ఫైర్
programme.sub-title: It's the end of November in the Luangwa Valley, and the rains have just begun. It marks the end of one of the toughest dry seasons on record, and triggers a transition from parched wilderness to luscious wetland
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వర్షాలు అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థగా మారుస్తున్న లుయాంగ్వా లోయలోని కాలానుగుణ మార్పులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ఎ గేమ్ ఆఫ్ లెపర్డ్ థ్రోన్స్
programme.sub-title: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని సాబి సాండ్స్‌లో ఉన్న చిరుతపులి రాజ కుటుంబ సభ్యుల మధ్య వివాదం గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: As Patrick Aryee delves into the feline family tree, the biologist witnesses gravity-defying 'catrobatics', tests the speed of a cheetah, and explores the odd-looking Pallas's cat
programme.desc: ఒకజీవశాస్త్రవేత్త, అడవి ప్రాంతాన్ని పాలించే 37 రకాల పిల్లుల విజయాన్ని, వాటి వైవిధ్యమైన కుటుంబ వృక్షాన్ని వెలికితీస్తాడు.

programme.title: వరల్డ్స్ వైల్డెస్ట్
programme.desc: World's Wildest.

programme.title: లయన్ క్వీన్స్: ఫైటింగ్ ఫర్ సర్వైవల్
programme.sub-title: Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat
programme.desc: తమ భూభాగంలో నివసించే రుహాలోని ఆడసింహాలు భూమిని ఇతర అడవి జంతువులతో పంచుకోవలసి వచ్చినప్పుడు కొత్త వ్యూహాలు సిద్ధంచేస్తాయి.

programme.title: Krugers Wild Kingdom
programme.desc: Krugers Wild Kingdom.

programme.title: బాస్టన్స్ ఆఫ్ ద జెయింట్స్
programme.sub-title: An engrossing journey into the lives of Asian Elephants, and the stunning bio-diverse North Eastern jungles of India around the river Brahmaputra
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, ఈశాన్య భారతదేశంలోని అడవులలో నివసించే ఆసియా ఏనుగుల జీవితాలు, మానవులు, జంతు పరిరక్షణ ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ ఆఫ్ ద సెరెంగేటి
programme.sub-title: Cameras reveal the last secrets of Africa's largest wild lions by following two prides
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సెరెంగేటిలో వాతావరణ మార్పుల మధ్య మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడుతున్న సింహం, చిరుత జాతుల జీవితాల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.sub-title: Hundreds died when the Sobral Santos sank on the Amazon, many of whom were rumoured to have been eaten alive. Jeremy Wade retraces the doomed boat's last voyage to discover what was behind the event

programme.sub-title: The Glade is a paradise in the desiccated plains of Ruaha, where water is available year round. This bounty spawns strange relationships. But peace in the Glade is shattered when thousands of buffalo arrive to drink, followed by the Baobab pride

programme.sub-title: The most elemental and pure survival is based on eating. If you are not healthy, strong and agile, you cannot compete to mate, you cannot defend your family from any threat, nor will you be able to achieve good status in your clan

programme.title: వరల్డ్స్ వైల్డెస్ట్

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker follows the extraordinary journey of closely-bonded wild dogs in Zimbabwe, capturing their tender moments to wild hunting

programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్: పవర్ ఆఫ్ ది ప్యాక్
programme.sub-title: From the Arctic tundra to the Great Plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire Northern Hemisphere; wolves are icons of the wilderness and spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: యానిమల్స్ ఎట్ నైట్
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: యూరప్స్ అమెజాన్
programme.sub-title: A journey of 750 km down the Drava river, starting from the river's Alpine origins and ending at its Pannonian Basin outlet
programme.desc: ద్రావా, డాన్యూబ్ నదుల సంగమ స్థానంలో నెలకొని ఉన్న చిత్తడి నేల పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థ చాలా వరకు ఇనుప తెర వెనుక దాగి ఉంది.

programme.title: బ్రదర్‌హుడ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: Five male lion cubs compete with each other while hunting their prey, leading to their rise to reign in the territory, thereby complicating the family ties
programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: ది హిప్పో కింగ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the not so well known story, the true nature and life of a seriously misunderstood and neglected mammal on earth, a giant hippo bull
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఒక పెద్ద హిప్పో బుల్ నిజమైన స్వభావం,అంతగా తెలియని జీవితంపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Wild Sri Lanka
programme.sub-title: The central highlands of Sri Lanka is a region of rich biodiversity and therefore acts as a home to numerous unique flora and fauna
programme.desc: The filmmaker unearths Sri Lanka's most biologically diverse ecosystem that is packed with the stealthiest and most ferocious animal kingdom like leopards and giant sea creatures.

programme.title: నైట్ ఆన్ ఎర్త్: ఆఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the captivating nocturnal adventures of different animals after dusk falls on the African savanna
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఆఫ్రికన్ సవన్నాలో సంధ్యా సమయం తర్వాత వివిధ జంతువుల ఆకర్షణీయమైన రాత్రిపూట సాహసాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: ది టీత్ ఆఫ్ ది సవన్నా
programme.sub-title: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there
programme.desc: ఆఫ్రికా అరణ్యాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, అక్కడ నివసించే వివిధ జీవజాతుల గురించి తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: లయన్స్ వర్సెస్ హైనాస్
programme.sub-title: Wildlife experts offer detailed insights into lionesses and hyenas nursing their young and teaching them how to adapt to the wild
programme.desc: చిత్రదర్శకుడు ఎన్నో ఏళ్లుగా ప్రజలు తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుంటున్న సింహాలు, హైనాల మధ్య జరిగే సంఘర్షణ గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ ఆఫ్ ద సెరెంగేటి
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the life of a lion and cheetah family as they struggle to survive amidst climate change in Serengeti
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సెరెంగేటిలో వాతావరణ మార్పుల మధ్య మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడుతున్న సింహం, చిరుత జాతుల జీవితాల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: A dispersed Marsh Pride faces weakened protection from the six male warrior lions whilst Kabibi and Cloudy Eye desperately hunt to sustain their hungry new cubs
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: రైజ్ ఆఫ్ జాగ్వర్స్
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives of the elusive jaguars, highlighting their intelligence and hunting prowess that make them one of the most formidable predators in the world.

programme.title: గోల్డెన్ ఈగిల్: కాల్ ఆఫ్ ది వైల్డ్
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: Wild Kashmir
programme.desc: Wild Kashmir.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: In Madagascar, the animals battle in an isolated tropical forest. Female lemurs carry their offspring for protection and hold on for dear life with panther chameleons
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ స్మాల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: While the winter floods tire Melelo's pride, elsewhere, Sephiri encounters something scary that puts her in a critical position
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: నేచర్స్ ఫాస్ట్ ఎటాక్స్
programme.sub-title: In the age-old battle between predator and prey, subterfuge and speed can be a case of life or death for many animals from tigers to cuttlefish
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు తమవేగాన్ని, చురుకుదనాన్ని ఉపయోగించి తమ ఎరను పట్టుకునే వేటాడే జంతువులను చూపడానికి ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఆస్ట్రేలియా
programme.sub-title: Survivors recount incidents of being lost in the Australian wilderness, getting stuck underground and having close encounters with some of the country's deadliest inhabitants
programme.desc: ప్రాణాలతో బయటపడినవారు ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ అవుట్‌బ్యాక్ నుండి తాము ఎదుర్కొన్న భయంకరమైన తప్పించుకునే అనుభవాలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: రైజ్ ఆఫ్ జాగ్వర్స్
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives of the elusive jaguars, highlighting their intelligence and hunting prowess that make them one of the top predators in the world.

programme.title: సీక్రెట్స్ ఆఫ్ ది ఫ్లడెడ్ ఫారెస్ట్
programme.sub-title: Explore the life of a family of brown bears in a year, the special characteristics of the rutting season of Roe Deer in the Mountains of Central Italy, and the migration of salamanders in autumn
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు డానుబే నదీతీర అడవుల పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలో అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న ప్రత్యేకమైన వన్యప్రాణుల రూపాన్ని అందించారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: Zoologist Patrick Aryee comes within a whisker of some of Earth's most majestic predators as he embarks on a remarkable journey through the feline family tree
programme.desc: ఒకజీవశాస్త్రవేత్త, అడవి ప్రాంతాన్ని పాలించే 37 రకాల పిల్లుల విజయాన్ని, వాటి వైవిధ్యమైన కుటుంబ వృక్షాన్ని వెలికితీస్తాడు.

programme.title: రివర్ మాన్స్టర్స్
programme.sub-title: Jeremy Wade sets out to investigate a sea monster that has washed up on an English beach. His journey takes him to the ice sheets of Greenland and the fjords of Norway
programme.desc: జీవశాస్త్రవేత్త జెరెమీ వేడ్ పురాణాలు, స్వచ్ఛమైననీటి రహస్యాలు, జానపద కథలను అన్వేషించడానికి బయలుదేరాడు.

credits.actor: Jeremy Wade,Vic Hislop,David Buckmeier,Mark Spitzer,Tim Mousseau,Daniel Göz

programme.title: హిప్పోస్ ఆఫ్టర్ డార్క్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సింహాల అహంకారం, హిప్పోల మంద మధ్య రాత్రి పడుతుండగా భయంకరమైన ఎద్దు రక్షణలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాటాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: గ్లోరియస్ గ్రాస్‌ల్యాండ్స్
programme.desc: Like a sea of grass, the savannah, prairie and meadows are among the most productive habitats on Earth, housing some of the greatest concentrations of big game and dramatic interactions between predator and prey.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బ్యాటిల్ గ్రౌండ్
programme.sub-title: Animals face intense challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: The filmmaker provides insights into some of the unique characteristics of various predatory animals while focusing on their survival instincts.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers detailed insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: వ్యాలీ ఆఫ్ ఫ్లడ్ అండ్ ఫైర్
programme.sub-title: The end of November marks the finish of one of the toughest dry seasons on record, and triggers a transition from parched wilderness to lush wetland
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వర్షాలు అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థగా మారుస్తున్న లుయాంగ్వా లోయలోని కాలానుగుణ మార్పులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ఎ గేమ్ ఆఫ్ లెపర్డ్ థ్రోన్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the leopard who fiercely reigns as the queen of the territory, facing perils and also mother to eight cubs
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని సాబి సాండ్స్‌లో ఉన్న చిరుతపులి రాజ కుటుంబ సభ్యుల మధ్య వివాదం గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee begins his American adventure in the tangled jungles of Central America, where he meets the ocelot dynasty

programme.title: Jaane Do Mujhe
programme.desc: During a seemingly pleasant date with Aditya, arranged by her friends, Nisha hears a concerning noise from the washroom. She discovers Aditya unconscious on the floor and immediately calls her friend Priya for help. Surprisingly, Priya dismisses Nisha's concerns, suggesting it's all imaginary. This unexpected response casts doubt on Aditya's existence and the reality of the entire situation, leaving Nisha confused about what's real and what might be a product of her imagination.

programme.title: Loha Chor
programme.desc: A modest family from Haryana relocated to Dhanbad, Bihar, and took up residence in a government quarter that had previously been inhabited by the notorious Loha Chor gang during the 1980s in Bihar. SpongeBob Schwammkopf 6
SpongeBob SquarePants: No Hat for Pat / Toy Store Of Doom
programme.sub-title: Der hutlose Patrick / Spielzeuggeschäft des Grauens
programme.desc: Der hutlose Patrick: Patrick möchte auch zu denjenigen Geschöpfen gehören, die einer geregelten Arbeit nachgehen und - wie SpongeBob - als Insigne dessen einen Hut tragen. Dieses Ziel erreicht er auch, aber nur, indem er sich in der Krossen Krabbe als "umfallender Idiot" zum Gespött der Menge macht. Wie lange er diese gesundheitsgefährdende Tätigkeit wohl durchhält? Spielzeuggeschäft des Grauens: SpongeBob und Patrick sind ihrer Spielsachen überdrüssig und langweilen sich. Einen Ausweg aus der Not bietet ein neu eröffneter Spielzeugladen, das "Spielzeugfass". Die beiden wollen gar nicht mehr hinaus aus dem Geschäft und lassen sich über Nacht darin einschließen - doch damit beginnt der Horror.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: New Fish in Town / Love That Squid
programme.sub-title: Quallenfischendes Seifenblasenbläserpack / Ein Tintenfisch zum Verlieben
programme.desc: Patrick möchte sich ein paar Dollar dazuverdienen und daher seinen Vorgarten vermieten. Thaddäus ist davon wenig begeistert - bis der erste Mietinteressent eintrifft, ein künstlerisch-musisch interessierter Herr, der gern Tee trinkt. Thaddäus' Begeisterung bekommt allerdings einen herben Dämpfer, als er von der heftigen Abneigung seines potentiellen Nachbarn gegen Quallenfischer und Seifenblasenbläser erfährt. Hektisch versucht er nun, SpongeBob und Patrick fern zu halten, und das Unheil nimmt seinen erwartungsgemäßen Lauf... // Völlig unerwartet verliebt sich Thaddäus Knall auf Fall in eine Kundin der Krossen Krabbe. Nachdem SpongeBob seinem Kollegen ein Date mit der Angebeteten verschafft hat, geht er mit ihm die Details einer solchen ersten Verabredung am praktischen Beispiel durch - bis Thaddäus der Geduldsfaden reißt..

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2
Rock, Paper, Scissors: Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke / Scissors' Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Papier und Bleistift erzählen einen Witz / Scheres Orchester
programme.desc: Papier und Bleistift erzählen auf einer Party einen irgendwie lustigen Witz und sind schockiert, dass sie zum ersten Mal in ihrem Leben tatsächlich Lacher bekommen. Sie versuchen daraufhin, dieses Gefühl zu wiederholen, indem sie den Witz so vielen Leuten wie möglich erzählen - doch sie verstehen nicht, warum er nicht mehr so gut ankommt wie vorher. Schere bekommt einen Job und versucht absichtlich so schlecht zu arbeiten, dass er gefeuert wird - nur um den legendären Satz sagen zu können: ,Ihr könnt mich nicht feuern, ich kündige!' // Schere ist traurig und engagiert ein Orchester, das ihn überall begleitet und sein Leben musikalisch untermalt. Als Stein und Papier sich über die ständige Hintergrundmusik beschweren, fragt er sich, was hinter seiner Traurigkeit steckt, und erkennt, dass ihm Liebe fehlt. Außerdem ist die Frau seiner Träume die berühmte Schauspielerin Cate Blankett, und er hätte keine Chance bei ihr... außer ihre Beziehung wäre dauerhaft von romantischer Musik begleitet als wären sie verliebt.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2
Rock, Paper, Scissors: Shoot / Rock's First Day of Work
programme.sub-title: Shoot / Steins erster Arbeitstag
programme.desc: Es war einmal Schere, Stein, Papier, Shoot' - das Trio hing früher mit einem Bambusspross namens Shoot ab, der sie mit endlosen Wettbewerben völlig erschöpfte. Nach einer zehnjährigen Challenge kehrt Shoot zurück, bereit für mehr. Die drei wollen ihm sagen, dass sie genug haben und keine Freunde mehr sein wollen, bringen es aber nicht übers Herz und landen stattdessen in seinem nächsten Wettbewerb: eine Million Dollar durch Landwirtschaft verdienen. // Stein freut sich auf seinen ersten Tag als Assistent von Franz Roll, doch sein exzentrischer Boss stellt sich als extrem anspruchsvoll heraus. Währenddessen entwirft Schere eine Puppe von sich selbst und lässt sie seine Arbeit erledigen.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 14
SpongeBob SquarePants: Snow Yellow
programme.sub-title: Schneegelbchen
programme.desc: SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Abrasive Side / Earworm
programme.sub-title: Die kratzbürstige Seite / Der Ohrwurm
programme.desc: SpongeBob kann einfach nicht nein sagen und ist deswegen unglücklich. Gary will Abhilfe schaffen und bestellt beim Putzmittelhandel eine Scheuerschwammfläche. Die passt SpongeBob wie angegossen, doch seine neue kratzbürstige Seite ist nicht jedermanns Sache... // Der aktuelle Hit "Mein Gedudel" geht SpongeBob nicht mehr aus dem Kopf. Ständig muss er das Lied hören bzw. vor sich hin singen. Dabei unterlaufen ihm zunächst einige Unkonzentriertheiten, mit der Zeit aber treibt ihn der Ohrwurm mehr und mehr in den Wahnsinn. Doch wie vertreibt man diesen Ohrwurm wieder aus dem Schwammkopf.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Hide and Then What Happens? / Shellback Shenanigans
programme.sub-title: Versteck und Irrtum / Schneckenhaus-Schummeleien
programme.desc: Patrick hat die Regeln des Versteckspiels bzw. dessen Existenz überhaupt vergessen. Dieses Faktum kostet SpongeBob viel Geduld, noch mehr Mühe und eine lange, aber auch lehrreiche Suche... // Anlässlich des "Bring-dein-Haustier-mit-zur-Arbeit"-Tags reift in Plankton ein teuflischer Plan: Er luchst Gary vorübergehend dessen Schneckenhaus ab und gibt sich selbst als SpongeBobs Haustier aus. Der ist jedoch tief geschockt davon, dass sein Schneckchen plötzlich grün ist und reden kann - und so findet sich Plankton bald auf der Intensivstation der Tierklinik wieder..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Masterpiece/Whelk Attack
programme.sub-title: Kunst und Krabbe / Verschleimt und verschlungen
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs verliert Kundschaft an ein konkurrierendes Restaurant, das als Attraktion eine Statue des Inhabers als Kinder-Kletterfels aufbietet. Nun will sich auch Mr. Krabs in Stein meißeln lassen. Doch verfolgenden er und Thaddäus als ausführender Künstler wirklich dieselben Interessen? // Eine Horde riesiger Wellhornschnecken droht, ganz Bikini Bottom zu verschlingen - oder wenigstens ordentlich einzuschleimen. Nichts scheint die Monster aufhalten zu können. Da hat Sandy die entscheidende Idee..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: You Don't Know Sponge / Tunnel of Glove
programme.sub-title: Von Tuten und Schwamm keine Ahnung / Im Fingerling der Liebe
programme.desc: SpongeBob und Patrick spielen ein Freundschaftsquiz, doch Patrick kann nicht einmal die einfachsten Fragen beantworten. Tief enttäuscht von solcher Ignoranz zieht SpongeBob sich zurück und leidet mehr oder weniger still vor sich hin. Und was macht Patrick? // Ein Zufall will es, dass Perla und SpongeBob im selben Boot sitzen, wenn auch nur während einer Fahrt im Vergnügungspark. Doch diese Fahrt dauert lange - und sie hat es in sich, nicht zuletzt dank Patrick, der das Fahrgerät zwar unabsichtlich, aber umso nachhaltiger sabotiert..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Krusty Dogs / The Wreck of the Mauna Loa
programme.sub-title: Krosse Dogs / Das Wrack der Mauna Loa
programme.desc: Mehr zum Zeitvertreib formt SpongeBob aus Hackfleischresten ein Würstchen. Bei der Kundschaft stößt die Kreation auf Begeisterung, und bald stellt Mr. Krabs das Angebot voll auf "Krosse Dogs" um - mit der Konsequenz, dass die Krabbenburger von der Karte und der Grill aus der Küche verbannt werden. Dies ist nun gar nicht in SpongeBobs Sinn, und bald beginnt er, Widerstand zu leisten... // Beim Spielen stoßen SpongeBob und Patrick zufällig auf ein altes Schiffswrack. Die Mauna Loa war einst wohl ein Piratensegler und bietet den beiden einen idealen Spielplatz. Doch als Mr. Krabs trotz aller Geheimhaltungsversuche Wind davon bekommt, ist es aus mit der Idylle, denn die Geldgier lässt SpongeBobs Chef einmal mehr alle Hemmungen beiseite wischen..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: New Fish in Town / Love That Squid
programme.sub-title: Quallenfischendes Seifenblasenbläserpack / Ein Tintenfisch zum Verlieben
programme.desc: Patrick möchte sich ein paar Dollar dazuverdienen und daher seinen Vorgarten vermieten. Thaddäus ist davon wenig begeistert - bis der erste Mietinteressent eintrifft, ein künstlerisch-musisch interessierter Herr, der gern Tee trinkt. Thaddäus' Begeisterung bekommt allerdings einen herben Dämpfer, als er von der heftigen Abneigung seines potentiellen Nachbarn gegen Quallenfischer und Seifenblasenbläser erfährt. Hektisch versucht er nun, SpongeBob und Patrick fern zu halten, und das Unheil nimmt seinen erwartungsgemäßen Lauf... // Völlig unerwartet verliebt sich Thaddäus Knall auf Fall in eine Kundin der Krossen Krabbe. Nachdem SpongeBob seinem Kollegen ein Date mit der Angebeteten verschafft hat, geht er mit ihm die Details einer solchen ersten Verabredung am praktischen Beispiel durch - bis Thaddäus der Geduldsfaden reißt..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Big Sister Sam / Perfect Chemistry
programme.sub-title: Geschwister des Grauens / Die Chemie stimmt
programme.desc: Patrick freut sich, denn seine große Schwester Sam, die er seit seiner Kindheit nicht mehr gesehen hat, kommt zu Besuch. Leider ist die junge Dame noch um einiges debiler, sozial untauglicher und vor allem unbeherrschter als ihr kleiner Bruder, so dass bald allerlei in Schutt und Asche liegt, vor allem deshalb, weil Thaddäus sich der Zerstörungswut nicht kampflos beugen will... // Aufgrund der Durchführung verschiedener Experimente kommen Plankton und Sandy sich auf wissenschaftlicher Ebene näher und werkeln nun gemeinsam an einem Teleporter. Dass sich Plankton damit letztlich nur zur Krabbenburger-Geheimformel beamen will, ist klar - aber weiß Sandy das auch.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Accidents Will Happen / The Other Patty
programme.sub-title: Verunfallt / Schwabbelburger
programme.desc: Thaddäus wird während eines Nickerchens im Lager der krossen Krabbe unter einem Regal begraben und erzählt nun einiges über Arbeitsunfälle und verstauchte Knöchel. Seine Drohungen, den Unfall der Obersten Werktätigen-Sicherheitsbehörde O.W.S. zu melden, sind erstklassiges Erpressungsmaterial gegenüber Mr. Krabs - aber wie lange wird er damit durchkommen? // Einmal mehr liegen sich Mr. Krabs und Plankton wegen der Krabbenburger-Geheimformel in den Haaren, als plötzlich eine neue Burgerbude an der Straße steht: Die "Schlappenburger" (2., 3. s.u.) werden zum Riesenerfolg und lassen unsere Streithähne nun wetteifern, wer als erstes das Rezept für diese Burger entwenden kann. SpongeBob wiederum ermahnt die beiden unermüdlich zur Kooperation - letztlich mit Erfolg, auch wenn er sich darüber kaum freuen kann..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Drive Thru/The Hot Shot
programme.sub-title: Autoschalter / Heiße Reifen
programme.desc: Ein kleiner baulicher Mangel und ein fortschrittlicher Kunde lassen Mr. Krabs das Serviceangebot der Krossen Krabbe um einen Autoschalter erweitern. Dies erweist sich in mehrfacher Hinsicht als durchschlagender Erfolg, da Mr. Krabs aufgrund des großen Andrangs per Vorschlaghammer Schalter um Schalter eröffnet, bis nicht nur sein Personal, sondern auch das örtliche Straßennetz völlig überlastet ist... // Tony Junior, Sohn der Rennfahrerlegende Tony Flott wird in Mrs. Puffs Bootsfahrschule eingeschult. Tatsächlich hat der Junge das Talent seines Vaters geerbt, und tatsächlich scheint Mrs. Puffs Plan aufzugehen, dass ein wenig dessen auf den bislang unbelehrbaren SpongeBob abfärben möge - denn Tony Juniors Mantra "Lass los, sei cool" zeigt Wirkung. Bald sitzt SpongeBob sogar am Steuer eines Rennbootes! Leider ist das erwartungsgemäß der Anfang vom Ende..

programme.title: Hey Arnold 4
Hey Arnold: Love and Cheese / Weighing Harold
programme.sub-title: Das Käsefest / Schlank um jeden Preis
programme.desc: Das Käsefest: Arnold versucht Lila dazu zu bringen sich in ihn zu verlieben indem er sie mit zum Alljährlichen Käsefest nimmt. Helga versucht dies mit allen Mitteln zu verhindern, doch jeder ihrer Pläne schlägt fehl und bringt Arnold und Lila nur noch näher zu zusammen. Schlank um jeden Preis: Harold fühlt sich zu dick und bittet daher seine Eltern, ihn zu einer Schlankheitsfarm zu schicken. Als er zurückkommt ist er dicker denn je. Arnold entschließt sich ihm zu helfen sein altes Gewicht wieder zu erreichen.

programme.title: Hey Arnold 4
Hey Arnold: It Girl / Deconstructing Arnold
programme.sub-title: Das Modepüppchen / Alle gegen Arnold
programme.desc: Das Modepüppchen: Helga wird das neueste Kindermode Model und jeder liebt sie wegen ihrer finsteren Miene und ihrer gemeinen Art. Anfangs läuft alles noch ganz gut, doch dann entdeckt Helga, dass jeder versucht wie sie zu sein. Da sie aufgrund des Vertrages, den sie unterschrieben hat, nicht aufhören kann, versucht sie deshalb so gemein wie möglich zu sein, damit sie gefeuert wird. Doch je gemeiner sie ist, desto mehr lieben sie die Leute. Arnold rät ihr schließlich, einfach mal nett zu sein. Alle gegen Arnold: Als die Freunde mit der Zeit genug von Arnolds dauernden Ratschlägen haben, entschließen sie sich überhaupt nicht mehr auf ihn zu hören. Doch als jeder von ihnen in Schwierigkeiten gerät, erkennen sie, dass sie Arnold brauchen um ihnen aus dem Schlammassel zu helfen.

programme.title: Hey Arnold 4
Hey Arnold: Grudge Match / Polishing Rhonda
programme.sub-title: Entscheidungsspiel / Der Benimmunterricht
programme.desc: Entscheidungsspiel: Big Bob und Opa haben einen Auffahrunfall mit geringem Blechschaden. Aber sie können sich nicht einigen, wer der Schuldige ist. Da kommt Big Bob auf die Idee, sich in einem Golfspiel mit Opa zu duellieren. Der Verlierer muss die Reparatur bezahlen. Opa willigt ohne zu Zögern ein. Doch zu Hause erkennt er, dass er gar nicht Golf spielen kann, er hat es mit Tennis verwechselt! Arnold überredet Opa, nicht zu kneifen und Golf zu lernen. Mit dem Erwerb der Schläger bekommt Opa ein Video "Wie lerne ich Golf spielen" gratis dazu. Im Schlaf erlernt Opa, wie man Golf spielt. Und als das große Spiel steigt, ist Opa richtig gut. Er spricht sich die Verse aus dem Video vor und trifft immer ins Schwarze. Und so gewinnt er mit knappem Vorsprung das Duell gegen Big Bob... Der Benimmunterricht: In der Schule geraten Rhonda und Patty aneinander. Daraufhin soll Rhonda endlich Umgangsformen lernen. Ihre Eltern schicken sie in einen Kurs zu Madame Parvenu. Aber dort trifft sie wieder auf Patty. Während Patty sich in dem Kurs sehr gut macht, hat Rhonda Probleme durch ihre Überheblichkeit. Schließlich fragt Rhonda Patty um Hilfe und Rat. Die gutmütige Patty hilft ihr natürlich. So besteht Rhonda diesen Kurs mit Bravour. Doch die Freundschaft zwischen Patty und Rhonda dauert nicht lange.

programme.sub-title: Aufgeblasen / Die Wachsfigur
programme.desc: SpongeBob möchte gerne dicke Muckis haben, doch die Sache mit dem harten Training ist die seine nicht. Da sieht er im Fernsehen einen Werbespot für aufblasbare Arm-Attrappen und läuft im Folgenden als furchterregender Hüne durch Bikini Bottom. Doch als es darauf ankommt, bei einem Anker-Weitwerf-Wettbewerb seine Kraft zu demonstrieren, versagt er naturgemäß kläglich. // Thaddäus hat sich selbst in Wachs modelliert. SpongeBob und Patrick verwechseln die Wachsfigur mit dem echten Thaddäus und machen erfolglose wiederbelebungsversuche. Da kommt Thaddäus frischgebadet und etwas bleich aus dem Badezimmer. Sponge und Pat glauben, der Geist des verblichenen Thaddäus stehe vor ihnen. Der nützt das in der Folge weidlich aus und lässt sich von den beiden bedienen. Doch dann wird Sponge auf die Legende vom Fliegenden Holländer aufmerksam und setzt nun alles daran, um dem angeblichen Geist zur ewigen Ruhe zu verhelfen.

Der gibt sich zwar alle erdenkliche Mühe, doch erwartungsgemäß endet der Abend in einer Katastrophe. Aber wenigstens hatten die beiden ihren Spaß. // Eigentlich sind Thaddäus Auszeichnungen egal. Doch Mr. Krabs schafft es durch einen Trick, SpongeBob und Thaddäus in einen erbitterten Wettkampf um den Titel "Mitarbeiter des Monats" zu verwickeln.

Doch bevor sich die Koronarverschlüsse mehren, fühlt sich SpongeBob zum Eingreifen verpflichtet... // SpongeBob belauscht ein Telefongespräch seines Chefs und denkt daraufhin fälschlicherweise, der wolle ihn loswerden. Daher besorgt er einen Spielkameraden für sein Schneckchen. Doch der süße Flauschibauschi entpuppt sich als Monster und der arme Gary muss um sein Leben kämpfen..

Die sorgt sowohl für Begeisterung als auch für unklare Besitzverhältnisse, denn SpongeBob hat Patrick das Essen bezahlt. Nun heißt es teilen, und das erweist sich als schwierig... // Beim Jahrestreffen der Liga der knickerigen Krabben ist Mr. Krabs für den Knauserigste Krabbe-Preis nominiert! SpongeBob darf mit zu dem Treffen, um endlich in die Grundzüge des Geizes eingeweiht zu werden. Doch als er die Knauserigkeit seines Chefs in übertriebenen Worten schildern soll, wird's schwierig für unseren Schwamm..

programme.desc: Thaddäus wird während eines Nickerchens im Lager der krossen Krabbe unter einem Regal begraben und erzählt nun einiges über Arbeitsunfälle und verstauchte Knöchel. Seine Drohungen, den Unfall der Obersten Werktätigen-Sicherheitsbehörde O.W.S. zu melden, sind erstklassiges Erpressungsmaterial gegenüber Mr. Krabs - aber wie lange wird er damit durchkommen? // Einmal mehr liegen sich Mr. Krabs und Plankton wegen der Krabbenburger-Geheimformel in den Haaren, als plötzlich eine neue Burgerbude an der Straße steht: Die "Schlappenburger" (2., 3. s.u.) werden zum Riesenerfolg und lassen unsere Streithähne nun wetteifern, wer als erstes das Rezept für diese Burger entwenden kann. programme.desc: Schere, Stein und Papier sind schockiert zu entdecken, dass die Ratten Bros in ihrer Freizeit Kinder unterrichten, was ihr Weltbild erschüttert, dass sie selbst die besseren Menschen seien. Die beiden Gruppen treten in einem ,Altruistik-Duell"' gegeneinander an - einem Wettbewerb darin, wer mehr Gutes für die Gesellschaft tun kann. Während die Ratten Bros feiern, dass sie Schere, Stein und Papier eifersüchtig gemacht haben, beginnt Brody zu hinterfragen, ob er wirklich aus Gutwillen handelt oder nur, um sie zu ärgern. // Schere geht mit Lolly, dem Popstar, aus - von der Stein und Papier große Fans sind. Nach einem katastrophalen Date veröffentlicht Lolly ein vernichtendes Album über Schere, wodurch er zum meistgehassten Menschen der Welt wird; sogar seine besten Freunde wenden sich gegen ihn. Schere muss seinen Ruf in der öffentlichen Meinung wiederherstellen.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2
Rock, Paper, Scissors: The Bedtime Story / Paper Takes the Phones
programme.sub-title: Handy-Verbot / Stein kann nicht schlafen
programme.desc: Papier ist frustriert darüber, dass Stein und Schere ständig auf ihre Handys starren, also nimmt er ihnen diese weg, um einen Tag echter gemeinsamer Zeit zu erzwingen. Anfangs sind sie widerwillig, aber bald genießen sie das alte, analoge Miteinander. Papier ist begeistert - bis er entdeckt, dass währenddessen eine Zombie-Apokalypse ausgebrochen ist. Schlimmer noch: Wenn Stein und Schere davon erfahren, könnte ihre Freundschaft zerstört werden. // Stein beschwert sich, dass er nicht schlafen kann, also versuchen Papier und Schere, ihm eine Gute-Nacht-Geschichte zu erzählen. Doch alle drei haben völlig unterschiedliche Vorstellungen davon, was eine gute Geschichte ist - Papier verliert sich in Details, Schere übertreibt mit wilden Wendungen, und Stein ist ein harter Kritiker. Wie bei Goldlöckchen müssen sie eine Geschichte finden, die genau richtig ist.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
SpongeBob SquarePants: Scaredy Pants / I Was a Teenage Gary
programme.sub-title: Das große Gruseln / Zur Schnecke gemacht
programme.desc: Das große Gruseln: Es ist Halloween, und SpongeBob hat ein Problem. Er gruselt sich vor allem und jedem, aber ihn will niemand gruselig finden. Mit Hilfe von Patrick macht er sich ein "gruseliges" Kostüm zurecht, das unter anderem auch einen radikalen Haar-oder vielmehr Schwammschnitt mit sich bringt. Aber auch damit bleiben die Erfolge bescheiden. Da taucht auf der Halloween-Party in der Krossen Krabbe plötzlich der echte Fliegende Holländer auf, dem seine schlechten Kopisten auf die Nerven gehen. Doch als er SpongeBob seines Kostüms entledigt und sieht, was sich darunter versteckt, bekommt auch er es mit der Angst zu tun... Zur Schnecke gemacht: Unwillig erklärt sich Thaddäus bereit, auf SpongeBobs Schnecke Gary aufzupassen. Als dieser von seiner Reise zurückkehrt, muss er feststellen, wie sehr sein Nachbar Gary vernachlässigt hat.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
SpongeBob SquarePants: SB-129 / Karate Choppers
programme.sub-title: Die Zeitmaschine / Karatefieber
programme.desc: Die Zeitmaschine: Thaddeus flüchtet vor seinen penetranten Nachbarn ins Kühlhaus der Krossen Krabbe und schließt sich dort ein. 200 Jahre später wird er von den High Tech-Nachkommen von SpongeBob aufgetaut. In der Zukunft verfügt man über Zeitmaschinen, und Thaddeus beamt sich sogleich in die tiefste Vergangenheit. Dort stößt er auf SpongeBobs und Patricks Vorfahren, denen er das Quallenfischen beibringt (und damit seine meistgehasste Sportart selbst erfunden hat). Doch sein Klarinettenspiel stößt auch in der Tiefseevorzeit nicht auf Gegenliebe, und so rettet sich Thaddeus nach einem kurzen Zwischenspiel im Nichts wieder in die Gegenwart..." Karatefieber: Sandy und SpongeBob sind im Kampfsportfieber. Ständig liefern sie sich Karatewettkämpfe. Diese Fixierung wirkt sich allerdings negativ auf SpongeBobs Arbeit in der Krossen Krabbe aus, und Sandy kann gerade noch verhindern, dass er gefeuert wird. Nun versuchen die beiden, eine andere Freizeit-beschäftigung zu finden, aber das erweist sich als schwierig, ja geradezu unmöglich. Doch wenigstens erfinden sie eine neue Disziplin: Burgerzubereitungs-Karate - wodurch auch Mr. Krabs ein Einsehen hat..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Curse of Bikini Bottom / Squidward in Clarinetland
programme.sub-title: Geistifiziert / Der spinnt, der Spind
programme.desc: SpongeBob und Patrick stören mit Thaddäus' Rasenmäher die Geisterruhe des Fliegenden Holländers und rasieren ihm dabei auch noch den Bart ab. Zur Strafe werden sie ebenfalls in Geister verwandelt, was ihnen als Daseinsmodell aber bereits nach kurzer Zeit außerordentlich missfällt... // Thaddäus pocht gegenüber Mr. Krabs auf einen sicheren Ort zur Unterbringung seiner Klarinette. Der stellt daraufhin seinen alten Marinespind zur Verfügung. Kollege SpongeBob wiederum verwandelt das alte, verrostete Ding erst in ein Schmuckstück und dann in ein immer gigantischeres Lager, ja Logistikzentrum gar, aus dem Thaddäus kaum noch herausfindet..

programme.sub-title: Schere ist ein ganz Lieber / Papiers Familientreffen
programme.desc: Stein will seinem Boss Franz Roll näherkommen und lädt ihn ein. Doch als Franz ankommt und Schere zum ersten Mal sieht, hält er ihn für einen Hund. Schere spielt die Illusion mit, da er in Franz' Villa ein komfortables Leben erwartet, wenn dieser ihn adoptiert. Franz und Schere kommen sich näher, was Stein frustriert, während er versucht, Franz zur Vernunft zu bringen. Papier wiederum versucht verzweifelt zu beweisen, dass er nicht langweilig ist. // Papier fürchtet das jährliche Familientreffen, da seine Familie extrem erfolgreich ist: seine Schwester Sandpapier ist Actionstar, sein Vater Backpapier ein berühmter Koch, seine Mutter Zeitungspapier eine bekannte Journalistin und sein Bruder Toilettenpapier ein weltberühmter Comedian. programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2

programme.sub-title: Muhnami 12 / Spinnen-Gericht
programme.desc: Schere, Stein und Papier wollen den zwölften Film ihrer Lieblingsreihe Muhnami sehen. Im Kuhkostüm und voller Vorfreude merken sie jedoch, dass Snacks inzwischen absurd teuer sind. programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8

programme.sub-title: Sportsfeinde / Andenken
programme.desc: Aufgrund schlechten Wetters verwandeln SpongeBob und Patrick das Schwammkopfsche Wohnzimmer in eine Minigolfanlage. Leider verlagert sich das Spielgeschehen irgendwann hinüber zu Nachbar Thaddäus, dessen Einrichtung unter wuchtigen Schlägen schwer zu leiden hat - und nicht nur die... // Patrick schimpft mit SpongeBob, weil der im Zuge des Frühjahrsputzes auch einige Andenken dem Müll überantwortet hat. Das nimmt sich unser Schwamm zu Herzen und hortet nun jede Kleinigkeit mit potentiellem Erinnerungswert - bis der Müll überhand nimmt und Thaddäus sich gezwungen sieht, die Gesundheitspolizei zu rufen..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Frozen Face Off
programme.sub-title: Unter Null unter Wasser
programme.desc: Das große Schlittenrennen von Bikini Bottom ist in diesem Jahr durch einen anonymen Gönner mit einer Million Dollar dotiert! Natürlich ist die ganze Stadt am Start. Natürlich versuchen einige, sich durch unlautere Tricks Vorteile zu verschaffen. Natürlich landen alle Bruchpiloten irgendwann in SpongeBobs Schlitten, den der arme Gary zu ziehen hat, und müssen sich neben den Unbilden der Witterung auch mit einem veritablen Schneemonster zur auseinandersetzen - und natürlich ahnt keiner unserer Helden, dass das ganze Rennen nur ein Ablenkungsmanöver Planktons ist, der damit hofft, endlich an die Krabbenburger-Geheimformel zu gelangen..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Squidward's School for Grown Ups / Oral Report
programme.sub-title: Gereifte Persönlichkeiten / Das Referat
programme.desc: Plötzlich und überraschend trägt Patrick einen Vollbart - für Thaddäus das erste Zeichen einer beginnenden Erwachsenwerdung. So nimmt er Patrick unter seine Fittiche und demonstriert ihm die Verhaltensweisen gereifter Persönlichkeiten. SpongeBob darf zunächst beobachtend dabei sein; nach allerlei Kindereien wird ihm das aber untersagt. In seiner Verzweiflung greift er zu hochkulturellen Mitteln... // Fleißig lernt SpongeBob für sein mündliches Referat über bootomobile Sicherheit. Obwohl zunächst guten Mutes, wächst seine Angst vor dem öffentlichen Vortrag mehr und mehr. Auch Sandy und Patrick können ihm nicht entscheidend weiterhelfen, so dass es am Ende erneut zu einer bootomobilen Fast-Katastrophe kommt..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Sweet and Sour Squid / The Googly Artiste
programme.sub-title: Tintenfisch süß-sauer / Der Kullerkünstler
programme.desc: Plankton versucht diesmal, über Thaddäus an die Geheimformel zu kommen, indem er dessen Vertrauen gewinnt. Getarnt als Musikliebhaber, gelingt ihm dies auch, allerdings zu dem Preis, dass Thaddäus vollends das Interesse an der Krossen Krabbe verliert und nun ganztägig entsetzlichen Radau mit seiner Klarinette veranstalten will. Entsetzt entreißt ihm Plankton schließlich das Instrument - und wird prompt verhaftet... // Thaddäus versucht diesmal, als Bildhauer die Kunstwelt zum Staunen zu bringen, indem er einen renommierten Kunstkritiker zur Begutachtung seiner neusten Skulptur lädt. Der lässt dafür aber weit weniger Begeisterung erkennen als für Patricks zusammengestümperte Kulleraugensteine. Und als unser Seestern sein Repertoire um Krabbenburger erweitert, wird er zum Star der Kunstszene..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Patrick's Staycation / Walking the Plankton
programme.sub-title: Hotel mit einem Seestern / Zweite Flitterwochen
programme.desc: Patrick fühlt sich urlaubsreif. Da es ihm jedoch an den Mitteln für eine Reisebuchung fehlt, verschafft ihm SpongeBob einen Hotelurlaub vom Feinsten und bis zur totalen Erschöpfung - oder war das alles nur ein böser Traum? // Mr.Krabs gewinnt eine Kreuzfahrt und nimmt sowohl SpongeBob als Leibdiener als auch die Geheimformel als Vorsichtsmaßnahme mit. Daher schifft sich Plankton nun ebenfalls ein, zusammen mit seinem glücklichen Computerweib Karen, die ihre zweiten Flitterwochen genießen will. Aber dafür muss sie ihre Urlaubs-App weit hochfahren..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Mooncation / Mr. Krabs Takes a Vacation
programme.sub-title: Der Schwamm im Mond / Mr. Krabs macht Ferien
programme.desc: Sandy möchte ihren Urlaub auf dem Mond verleben, doch während der Startvorbereitungen verschlägt es auch SpongeBob in die Rakete. Dies führt im Weiteren zu einigem Chaos, an dem die actionbegeisterte Sandy letztlich dann doch großen Spaß hat... // Mr. Krabs schließt die Krosse Krabbe, um einen längst überfälligen Urlaub mit Tochter Perla anzutreten. Dass SpongeBob ebenfalls mit von der Partie ist, passt Perla aber genauso wenig wie das letztliche Reiseziel, die Münzanstalt von Bikini Bottom. Mr. Krabs wiederum kann im Wortsinn kaum an sich halten vor Begeisterung und macht sich damit zunächst recht unbeliebt..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Ghoul Fools
programme.sub-title: Geisterdeppen
programme.desc: Ein Hausboot mit Maschinenschaden erregt SpongeBobs und Patricks Aufmerksamkeit. Bald müssen sie feststellen, dass das Gefährt von gruseligen Geistern bewohnt wird. Deren Kapitän schickt die beiden los, ein Ersatzteil für den Bootsmotor zu besorgen, nicht ohne ihre Seelen als Pfand zu behalten. Schlimm genug, doch als die Verzweifelten Mr. Krabs ihr Leid klagen, nimmt das Unheil erst richtig seinen Lauf. Denn der Geisterkapitän hat SpongeBob eine Dublone für das Ersatzteil mitgegeben, und die weckt nun Mr. Krabs' Geldgier..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Mermaidman Begins / Plankton's Good Eye
programme.sub-title: Meerjungfraumann: Wie alles anfing / Abgrundguter Plankton
programme.desc: Zu Beginn des Meerjungfraumann-und-Blaubarschbube-Fernseh-Marathons wird eine Spezialfolge über die Anfänge des Superheldenduos angekündigt. Die Unbilden der Witterung bringen es allerdings mit sich, dass SpongeBob und Patrick statt im heimischen Wohnzimmer in der Höhle der Superhelden sitzen, dafür aber aus erster Hand erzählt bekommen, wie alles anfing... // Nach einem weiteren vergeblichen Versuch von Plankton, die Krabbenburger-Formel zu entwenden, fällt Computerweib Karen ein ganz grundsätzlicher Defekt ihres Gatten auf: Es ist dessen Einäugigkeit und damit ein Mangel an räumlicher Wahrnehmung. Nach einigem Hin und Her benutzt Plankton schließlich eine DNS-Probe von SpongeBob, um sich ein zweites Auge wachsen zu lassen. Kann man jedoch mit einem solchen guten Auge noch böse sein.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
SpongeBob SquarePants: Sleepy Time / Suds
programme.sub-title: Nur geträumt / Der Blubber

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
SpongeBob SquarePants: Valentine's Day / The Paper
programme.sub-title: Das Valentinsgeschenk / Ein kleines Stück Papier
programme.desc: Das Valentins-Geschenk: Es ist Valentinstag und der Philanthrop SpongeBob beschenkt ganz Bikini Bottom. Für Patrick hat er sich natürlich etwas ganz Besonderes ausgedacht. So schleppt er den Freund auf den Rummelplatz und spannt ihn dort ordentlich auf die Folter. Doch das an Material und Logistik groß angelegte Geschenkprojekt droht zu scheitern - und Patrick wird zum Tier und versetzt den ganzen Rummelplatz in Angst und Schrecken. Ein kleines Stück Papier: Thaddeus wirft ein Bonbonpapier weg. SpongeBob findet es und bestürmt Thaddeus geradezu, es behalten zu dürfen. In der Folge stellt SpongeBob derart spektakuläre und spaßige Dinge mit dem Stückchen Papier an, dass Thaddeus immer neidischer wird und schließlich Haus und Hof gegen das Papier tauscht - vergebens.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Gramma's Secret Recipe / The Cent of Money
programme.sub-title: Besuch von Omama / Für eine Handvoll Kleingeld
programme.desc: Ein Besuch bei seiner Oma im Altersheim bringt Plankton auf eine geniale Idee - wer kann schon einer hilflosen Seniorin widerstehen? So gibt er sich bei SpongeBob so lange als dessen Uromama aus, bis ihn der angebliche Urenkel tatsächlich direkt zur Krabbenburger-Geheimformel bringt. Doch man unterschätze nie die Energie des Alters... // Als Mr. Krabs sieht, dass Gary Münzen tatsächlich magnetisch anzieht, gibt es kein Halten mehr für ihn. Während er SpongeBob mit langwierigen Arbeiten beschäftigt hält, plündert er ohne Rücksicht auf Verluste, und vor allem ohne Rücksicht auf Gary, die Kleingeldvorräte größerer Teile der örtlichen Bevölkerung. Als ihm SpongeBob endlich auf die Schliche kommt, bahnt sich bereits ein größeres Unheil an..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Monster Who Came to Bikini Bottom / Welcome to the Bikini Bottom Triangle
programme.sub-title: Monsterbesuch in Bikini Bottom / Willkommen im Bikini-Bottom-Dreieck
programme.desc: Zufällig begegnet Patrick einem riesigen Monster. Schnell freunden sich die beiden an. Auch SpongeBob ist die Kreatur sympathisch; nur dessen Art, mit den Wohnstätten seiner Spielkameraden umzugehen, stößt, nun ja, nicht auf ungeteilten Beifall. Schließlich muss das Monster die Stadt verlassen, findet aber dank SpongeBob dennoch seine Bestimmung... // SpongeBob und seinen Freunden kommen auf ungeklärte Art immer mehr Besitztümer abhanden. Bald zieht ein gespenstischer Nebel auf, der geheimnisvolle Gesang der Meerjungfrauen hebt an, und -schwupps! - findet man sich im Bikini-Bottom-Dreieck wieder. Also dort, wo nichts und niemand mehr wegkommt. Was tun.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Curse of the Hex / The Main Drain
programme.sub-title: Der Fluch des Banns / Kein Meer mehr
programme.desc: Hartherzig verweigert Mr. Krabs einer seltsamen alten Dame einen Krabbenburger zum ermäßigten Preis. Die belegt daraufhin die Krosse Krabbe mit einem Fluch. Tatsächlich blieben von Stund an die Gäste aus und allerlei Unfälle ereignen sich. Um den Bann zu lösen, müssen Mr. Krabs und SpongeBob nun eine gefährliche Aufgabe erfüllen... // Mr. Krabs erzählt SpongeBob und Patrick die schauerliche Geschichte des Hauptablassstopfens, den einst zwei Kinder im Spiel zogen und damit die ganze Unterwasserwelt in den Abgrund rissen. Vor allem Patrick will nun unbedingt diesen Ablassstopfen finden. Warum wohl.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Trenchbillies / Sponge-Cano
programme.sub-title: Hinterdeichler / Sponge-Kan
programme.desc: Beim Quallenfischen fallen SpongeBob und Patrick eine Klippe herunter und landen unter einer Sippe von tiefsten Hinterdeichlern. Einmal mehr bittet der den kleinen Schwamm darum, ihm nie mehr zu helfen - und einmal mehr muss Thaddäus diese Bitte, Aug in Aug mit der Katastrophe, diesmal in Gestalt eines ausbrechenden Vulkans, zurücknehmen..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 2
SpongeBob SquarePants: Something Smells / Bossy Boots
programme.sub-title: Mundgeruch / Die Kuschel-Krabbe
programme.desc: SpongeBob macht sich aus den Resten in Kühl- und Speiseschrank ein Sonntagsfrühstück, das übelsten Mundgeruch hervorruft. Das merken alle außer ihm, und er wundert sich, warum alle Leute in Panik vor ihm davonrennen. Patrick vermutet, es liege daran, dass Sponge so hässlich sei. Das stürzt unseren Schwamm zwar in schwerste Depressionen, ändert aber nichts am Sachverhalt. Erst als auch Patrick von der Stinkmampfe kostet, merken die beiden, was eigentlich los ist... Mr. Krabs kündigt an, dass seine Tochter Perla während ihrer Sommerferien in der Krossen Krabbe arbeiten werde und auch eine Menge neuer Ideen habe. In der Tat, denn Perla verwandelt die Burger-Bude ruck-zuck und unter Einsatz erheblicher finanzieller Mittel in ein Jugendlokal, dass den schönen Namen "Kuschelkrabbe" trägt. Nun gibt es Salat statt Burger und die Angestellten werden gezwungen, ausnehmend alberne Uniformen zu tragen. Thaddäus macht das alles nicht lange mit, und sogar der langmütige SpongeBob hält es irgendwann nicht mehr aus. Er geht zu Mr. Krabs, dem im Verlauf des Gesprächs schnell klar wird, dass er Geld zum Fenster hinauswirft. Doch er traut sich nicht, seine Tochter zu feuern. Nun soll SpongeBob das übernehmen - und macht dabei eine überraschende Feststellung..

programme.desc: Ein kleiner baulicher Mangel und ein fortschrittlicher Kunde lassen Mr. Krabs das Serviceangebot der Krossen Krabbe um einen Autoschalter erweitern. Dies erweist sich in mehrfacher Hinsicht als durchschlagender Erfolg, da Mr. Krabs aufgrund des großen Andrangs per Vorschlaghammer Schalter um Schalter eröffnet, bis nicht nur sein Personal, sondern auch das örtliche Straßennetz völlig überlastet ist... // Tony Junior, Sohn der Rennfahrerlegende Tony Flott wird in Mrs. Puffs Bootsfahrschule eingeschult. Tatsächlich hat der Junge das Talent seines Vaters geerbt, und tatsächlich scheint Mrs. Puffs Plan aufzugehen, dass ein wenig dessen auf den bislang unbelehrbaren SpongeBob abfärben möge - denn Tony Juniors Mantra "Lass los, sei cool" zeigt Wirkung.
